news.title: What’s Next For Halo Under Activision? Probably Not The Endless
news.summary: What likely would have been the big new enemy faction of the Halo universe, the Endless, have been fully revea

content.v: What likely would have been the big new enemy faction of the Halo universe, the Endless, have been fully revealed, though it's unclear what role, if any, they will play going forward.

As announced last month by Xbox's Matt Booty, Halo is under new management , with the responsibility of the next game in the series going to a completely new team under Activision. Halo Studios, formerly 343 Industries, will remain as a small team to oversee already-released titles like the recent Halo: Campaign Evolved. However, the majority of the studio, 268 people, have been laid off.

In the wake of the news, the latest (and now last) issue of the lore-focused Canon Fodder blog written by Halo Studios community writer Alex Wakeford has now become a parting gift from the studio to the community. In it, Wakeford reveals a glimpse at what the future of Halo might have looked like under Halo Studios' continued stewardship.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/XalanynEmergence.jpg?w=636

There are plenty of reveals within, including a look at Zeta Halo environments that may have at one time been planned for Halo Infinite DLC. But the biggest reveal is saved for last: an image that is the community's first full look at the Endless. This new enemy faction was teased in Halo Infinite via the Harbinger, a member of an advanced race that was imprisoned by the Forerunners on Zeta Halo due to their ability to survive the firing of the Halo rings.

In the blog the Endless are referred to as the Xalanyn, children of Abaddon. Wakeford doesn't elaborate further, but states that he hopes the image will "spark your imagination and let your canon curiosities run wild with endless questions."

Each member of the Endless looks wildly different. Some appear vaguely humanoid, while others look more like some type of sea creature. Every Endless member appears alongside a smaller creature that is reminiscent of their Endless counterpart. The Harbinger appears in the image alongside a Skimmer, a new enemy type encountered in Halo Infinite.

The image seems to point towards the Endless being almost a replacement of sorts for Halo's traditional Covenant faction, with each Endless supplying a smaller enemy type the Master Chief would have to battle against. Interestingly, an Engineer, an alien race used by the Covenant and seen in previous entries in the franchise, appears alongside a similar looking Endless in the image. This looks to imply the Engineers themselves were created or in some way linked to the Endless.

Unfortunately, this may be Halo fans' first, and last, look at the Endless. According to Halo insider Rebs Gaming , nobody at Halo Studios is currently involved in Activision's new Halo . Activision may completely disregard Halo Studios' work in favor of a clean slate , though Rebs does state Activision's game, while not a direct sequel to Halo Infinite, also won't "retcon any previously established canon."

Halo's move to Activision comes as Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has put a renewed emphasis on big franchises as part of her "Xbox reset" strategy that has seen widespread layoffs , game cancellations, and studio divestitures.

news.title: Gears of War E-Day Is a 'Natural Choice to Be an Exclusive' – Studio Head Mike Crump Claims Series Carries the Banner for Xbox
news.summary: Gears of War: E-Day launched this week, and while it is excellent, the game was pulled away from a PS5 launch

others.title: Xbox Game Pass Gets Gears Of War: E-Day And These 11 Games In October
Feature: 40+ PS5, PS4 Games to Buy in the PS Store Player's Choice Sale

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/01/gears-1790854472442.jpg

Gears of War: E-Day launched this week, and while it is excellent, the game was pulled away from a PS5 launch earlier this year. In a recent interview, The Coalition Studio Head Mike Crump claims that this was all part of the plan.

In an interview with the BBC , Crump defended the choice to be an Xbox exclusive, despite a likely ludicrous budget saying, "Gears has been an exclusive franchise to Xbox for 20 years now. It's sort of entwined deeply with the brand."

However, Gears of War: Reloaded did launch on PS5 last year, so the franchise as a whole isn't exactly Xbox-exclusive anymore. It's also likely that if E-Day did launch on PlayStation, it'd see higher sales numbers.

Crump claims that the metrics for success go further than that, though. He told the BBC that the series is meant to, at least in part, carry the banner for the Xbox platform and give people a "reason to be in the Xbox ecosystem." Queue Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's decision to pull the game from the PS5 release slate.

Regardless, the game will now likely have lower sales than it otherwise would have. When the BBC asked Crump about that, he insisted that the studio is taking a broader view than just looking at sales figures and retention numbers.

"We measure things like, are we showcasing the platform? Are we pushing the hardware to it limits? Are we showcasing what the Xbox is capable of? ...Our goal basically is to be the best-looking game on the Xbox and really show the industry what's possible with our hardware," he answered.

If the goal is to be a tech demo about what the Xbox consoles are capable of, I'd argue that it's a straight-up success. The game looks incredible on both the Xbox Series X and Series S, so much so that The Coalition had to rely on trickery with the Page File to get the game running smoothly on the less-powerful console. The game is also incredible, and our reviewer Ryan McCaffrey gave it a 9 , saying:

"By going back to the beginning, Gears of War: E-Day returns to the heart of this series: Marcus Fenix, Dom Santiago, and a Locust horde that’s as terrifying as it is dangerous. E-Day pulls off the tightrope act of giving us a heartfelt prequel with strong characters even when we know how it ends. On a more mechanical level, it also evolves the enemies, weapons, and combat you’d expect to deliver a Gears of War campaign that stands toe-to-toe with any of the others. It wraps up with 10 years still left to go before Marcus gets tossed in prison ahead of the events of the first Gears of War, so here’s hoping the next one stays in the past for a while longer – and that we don’t have to wait another seven years for it to arrive."

But even if the game is a critical hit and a technical marvel, sales numbers will inevitably play a role in the game's success, especially as Microsoft is currently in the middle of a months-long restructuring campaign. Right after launch, developers at The Coalition told Eurogamer they were expecting layoffs. However, Crump has since addressed those concerns , saying, "For us that's about shipping a great game that people are going to love and I feel like, as a team, we've done that."
Let's just hope that a pretty game and high review scores really are enough to keep the Xbox layoff machine at bay.

news.title: Capcom Clarifies Stance on AI After RE Engine Conference Comments
news.summary: Resident Evil and Street Fighter developer Capcom has clarified its stance on AI and its future plans for the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/07/capcom-clarifies-stance-on-ai-1791395067864.jpg
Resident Evil and Street Fighter developer Capcom has clarified its stance on AI and its future plans for the RE Engine in an exclusive conversation with IGN.

Capcom held its yearly recruitment conference on October 2, wherein programmer Satoshi Ishida outlined the company’s plans to incrementally improve its RE Engine using a program called REX (short for RE Next Engine).

Rather than building a new engine from scrap, Ishida explained that a series of steps will be taken to improve the RE Engine piece by piece. This includes the use of AI, which gave fans pause after the news broke online.

We bent the ear of a spokesperson at Capcom, who laid out the challenges its developers are currently facing that led the company to rethink how it makes games with the RE Engine. They confirmed that games are becoming increasingly colossal undertakings, to the point where titles now take up immense amounts of time and resources to create. With AI being a swiftly-advancing technology, Capcom saw the opportunity to use it to solve these issues and make its developers more efficient by improving their development tools, testing game code for them, and analyzing large chunks of data on their behalf, as well as other helpful benefits.

Capcom’s vision for REX is to implement these AI tools and efficiencies into the next iteration of the RE Engine to help the company make games faster with the strongest tools available to it. The spokesperson told us that Capcom has no plans to use generative AI in the creation of its games (which creates content based on a prompt, as opposed to other types of AI that are used to analyze patterns, make predictions, process data, etc.). Any AI used with the RE Engine will be for the express purpose of speeding up processes and helping development teams be more efficient.

This means that AI will not be used for creating assets or programs in games. Capcom said as much back in March during a shareholders’ meeting , where the company was asked how it intends to use artificial intelligence in its products.

“We will not implement assets generated by AI into our games.” Capcom said. “However, we plan to proactively use it as a contributing technology to improve the efficiency and productivity of the game development process. To this end, we are currently exploring ways to implement it in various areas, including graphics, sound and programming."
Upcoming Capcom games include Resident Evil Veronica and Mega Man: Dual Override.

news.title: Cities: Skylines Announced For Switch 2 While Sequel’s Console Ports Are Still MIA
news.summary: Paradox Interactive has announced Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition, a Nintendo Switch 2 port of Colossal Or

content.v: Paradox Interactive has announced Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition, a Nintendo Switch 2 port of Colossal Order's hit 2015 city-builder. While it's great to see Cities: Skylines make its way to a new platform, this announcement also serves as a reminder that we have no idea when the long-awaited console ports of Cities: Skylines 2 will come out.

Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition was developed by Tantalus Media, the team behind The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword's Switch port . It'll cost $49, include 10 expansions, expand the buildable area to 25 tiles, support keyboard and mouse, and add a map editor, plus better precision placement and environmental controls. Players can choose between a 30fps mode that focuses on visual quality or a performance mode targeting 60fps.

The Switch 2 port launches on October 28 and will be available at a 70% discount to those who already own the Switch 1 version. Holiday Getaways, Mansions & Manors, and Blueprint Beasts Radio content creator packs will be released for the PC, PS4, and Xbox One versions of the game on the same day.

While the original Cities: Skylines continues to be updated and ported to new platforms, Cities: Skylines 2 and its prospective console ports have had a much rockier journey. That sequel was supposed to be released the same day on PC and console in October 2023, but the console ports were pushed back to Spring 2024 ahead of release. When the PC version of Cities: Skylines 2 launched, it was riddled with bugs and other issues, and developer Colossal Order spent months fixing them.

In Spring 2024, the console ports of Cities: Skylines 2 were delayed again, this time to October 2024. Unfortunately, the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S ports were delayed again, and the developers admitted , "We have not yet met the stability and performance targets we set for the console release." Over two years later, the port is still not out.

In November 2025, Iceflake Studios took over development of Cities: Skylines 2 from Colossal Order, teasing that it will do "continuous work on the Editor and console editions." We have not heard anything about console ports of Cities: Skylines 2 since then.

As Tanatlus Media developed Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition for Switch 2, not Iceflake Studios, it's unlikely the releases are connected in any significant way. Still, the status of the Cities: Skylines 2 console ports remains a mystery, further complicated by this Switch 2 port announcement and the reveal of Lego Skylines for PC and console.

news.title: WoW: Forever Players Love It When Things Look Old
news.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players have made their feelings about the game's visual style crystal clear: They

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever players have made their feelings about the game's visual style crystal clear: They love it when things look old.

It's a recurring theme in the Forever beta, where players have continually pushed back against updated high-definition character models and character portraits. While Forever is in many ways a new version of Blizzard's MMORPG, it's built with the spirit and foundation of WoW Classic in mind, even as it includes updated visuals and quality-of-life updates taken straight from modern WoW. One of those new features is an option to use modern WoW's updated playable character and non-enemy NPC models.

According to the WoW content creator Savix , who tested an early version of Forever before it was publicly announced, developer Blizzard didn't originally plan to include the ability to swap between standard or high-def character models, instead only using HD models. The testers, many of them streamers and content creators from within the WoW Classic community, stressed how important it was to include an option for the game's original character models.

Blizzard thankfully listened, but every other instance of updated character models have been met with similar distaste from among the MMO's community. Whether it was intentional or by mistake, a quilboar boss was found to be using its modern WoW model and was met with backlash from players. It didn't take long for Blizzard to return the enemy back to how it looked in WoW Classic.

It's a similar story with the game's character creation portraits. For much of the beta, the Forever character-creation screen used HD portraits taken from modern WoW, to the disappointment of the community. Earlier this week that finally changed , with the game now using WoW's original character-creation portraits.

Blizzard seems to have gotten the message. Currently, the game's new playable Skyborne elf race only has HD models. That, too, sounds like it will soon change. In a comment attached to a video exploring Skyborne lore and abilities, Blizzard said to "stay tuned regarding Skyborne models," seemingly implying standard-definition versions of the Skyborne are on the way.

Even with these options, some players want more. Forever's user interface is a fascinating combination of old and new--cleaner and more streamlined similar to modern WoW, but inspired in many ways by WoW Classic. Currently, there's not a toggle option to swap between Forever's updated UI and WoW's original interface. For those who want the UI as it was 20 years ago, a player-made ClassicUI Forever add-on reverts many of Blizzard's changes to make everything from the game's action bars, spellbook, profession tab, character portraits, bags, and more look as they did in 2004.

I expect this push and pull to continue. WoW content creators have debated the clash between old and new found in Forever's art style, with many calling on Blizzard to pick a lane. For what seems like the majority of the Forever community, the answer is loud and clear--the older looking the better.

WoW: Forever's beta runs through October 21, with Forever's full launch coming November 4. A recent RMT controversy in the Forever beta saw Blizzard put its foot down when it comes to illegal gold buying . Meanwhile, Blizzard is asking players in a survey for their opinions on 11 potential new classes that could be added to Forever in the future.

news.title: FBI Arrests 29-Year-Old Alabama Man After Epic Reported Fortnite Voice Chat Threats
news.summary: The FBI arrested a Fortnite player last week after Epic reported threats he made over voice chat.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/07/fortnite-1791394391574.jpg
The FBI arrested a Fortnite player last week after Epic reported threats he made over voice chat.
Epic reported Edward Frith, an avid Fortnite player from Alabama, over alarming messages spoken while playing Fortnite. He was later arrested when the FBI turned up at his house.

According to the affidavit (reported by Aftermath ), Frith, who went by the username “WagesOfNinja,” said he was letting all his rage out because he wanted to “literally murder somebody” and that he thinks about killing “every day.”

"Let's see if the FBI is going to show up at my door because I'll shoot them motherf****rs too," Frith said, before the FBI showed up at his door. Frith’s other comments were just as disturbing, with the Fortnite player suggesting he was planning to end his life by charging at police.

Epic made what was described as a "voluntary emergency disclosure" to the FBI National Threat Operations Section (NTOS) Exigent Threat Research and Analysis Crisis Team (EXTRACT), relating to the statements. The developer then provided the FBI with an audio recording and transcript of the threats.

The Alabama resident was indicted for violating Interstate Threatening Communications on September 23. He was remanded into custody while awaiting a trial, after entering a plea of “not guilty” on September 24.

Epic Games announced a new voice reporting system for Fortnite in November 2023 . The system allows players to clip audio and anonymously file a report whenever they catch another player violating the community rules.

"The only way Epic ever receives a copy of the audio clip is if voice reporting is on and a participant affirmatively reports the voice chat using the in-game voice reporting feature,” Epic said at the time.

Once reported, the last five minutes of communications are captured and the audio file is sent to Epic’s moderation team to review. Depending on the severity of the communications, players can face bans or, in this case, being reported to the feds.

Likewise, Fortnite players can report text chat, which is stored for 30 days. The Fortnite developer also uses autonomous systems to detect harmful language, such as “self-harm, child endangerment, and threats of real-world violence.”
Photo by Jakub Porzycki/NurPhoto via Getty Images.

news.title: GTA 6 Wants Losing Your Wanted Level To Feel Like A “Hit-And-Run”
news.summary: Gamers hoping for GTA 6 to amp up the realism when it comes to losing their wanted level in the sunny state of

content.v: Gamers hoping for GTA 6 to amp up the realism when it comes to losing their wanted level in the sunny state of Leonida are in luck, with Rockstar confirming in a recent interview that Jason and Lucia can do far more than escape a glowing red zone on the map to shake off the law.

Speaking to IGN ahead of the Netflix Extended Look back in August, head of development and co-studio head Rob Nelson walked the outlet through a 30-minute gameplay demo in which several new mechanics and locations were detailed.

The demo begins in Jason and Lucia’s safehouse, one of many interactive personal spaces the player can call home in GTA 6. Here you can switch characters, partake in unique interactions, or even decorate the place to suit your style. However, Rockstar has stressed “this is not their own house, they’re staying in someone else’s house.”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_02.jpg?w=636

From here, Nelson takes Lucia on a stroll through downtown where an evolved version of Red Dead Redemption 2 ’s NPC interaction system is used to mess with random citizens, which can range from dangerous gangbangers to normal people jogging in the local park.

But now these interactions possess significantly more depth and go far beyond saying hello, being rude, or holding someone at gunpoint. Rockstar describes several examples such as eavesdropping on a conversation for too long and being called out, or following an NPC as he goes about his regular routine only for it to blow up into a moment that feels earned and can be tackled in a multitude of ways.

This is where the evolved wanted level system comes into play, although Rockstar has made it clear that you will still have an opportunity to cause untold chaos and murder hundreds of cops if you’re that way inclined, but doing so will come with significantly more variables since Rockstar doesn’t want GTA 6 to make you “all-powerful” like GTA 5 often did .

After an interaction ends with an NPC pulling a gun on Lucia and a group of people she has just interacted with, dispatch is called and a one-star wanted level star shows up on screen. If you manage to escape the area where the authorities are going to respond, you’ll be in the clear, but Nelson goes on to describe a number of ways this can be achieved.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_11_ef0290.jpg?w=636

“As much as possible, we tried to design the game so that you have options,” Nelson said. “Things can escalate quite quickly if you want them to, or people who don’t want to escalate can try to avoid it. It's not always possible! To me, that supports the narrative. This is a story about a couple on the run. We have tried to make the systems and the design support our narrative when and wherever possible. Meaning, if you hit and run, commit a crime and run, get into trouble and move on before the cops get there, and you don’t start shooting people, don't start escalating – which you absolutely can do if you want to – but if you don’t, you’re generally going to be fine.”

Nelson expands upon this system further after Lucia experiences another NPC interaction that puts the fuzz on her tail. Even if you haven’t killed someone, a stolen vehicle or beaten and bruised pedestrian is still going to raise both eyebrows and your wanted level. You can run away the old fashioned way, or decide to get a haircut, change your outfit, or even split up if Jason and Lucia happen to be travelling together.

“Again, if I take off here, I should be fine. We’re really trying to encourage this hit-and-run style of gameplay.” Nelson explains. “So, the police are looking for me. We have this heat system, and they know what I look like and what I’m wearing. Here’s a pair of glasses–I'll put on this and this baseball hat. But they still know what I'm wearing, so I would need to go to a clothing store or call my personal vehicle, which has changes of outfits in the trunk.”

The idea of being able to lose the law by dashing into an interconnected network of alleys or blending in amidst NPCs in a random storefront sounds thrilling, especially dynamic systems designed to keep you on their toes are constantly interacting with one another.

Outfits can become compromised, while cops will be quick to recognise what vehicle you’re travelling in or where you were last seen. But Nelson notes that “so long as you don’t draw too much attention to yourself, you should be fine.” Easier said than done in an open world as ripe with possibility as this one.
GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and according to reports it is already close to 6 million pre-orders more than a month before launch.

news.title: New Details Revealed For GTA 6’s Jason And Lucia, Including “Physical Intimacy”
news.summary: New information has come to light about GTA 6 , and specifically the partnership of its main characters, Jason

content.v: New information has come to light about GTA 6 , and specifically the partnership of its main characters, Jason and Lucia . In GTA 6, they are both partners in crime and lovers, and physical intimacy will be part of the experience, it seems.

Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said in an interview with IGN that physical intimacy is a "huge part" of a relationship, and that applies to GTA 6. Exactly how this may operate in GTA 6, however, remains a mystery. "It has to be done right," Nelson said.
"Like anything that we do, we have to iterate and try things and iterate on it until we figure out what feels right," he explained.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_03.jpg?w=636

GTA 6's ESRB rating says the game will have nudity and strong sexual content, and IGN reported that when switching characters, it can switch to Jason's POV while he is naked and in the shower. An international rating for GTA 6 specifically mentions how the game will have "sex scenes."

The GTA series has had its fair share of sex-related controversy. One of gaming’s biggest controversies ever, the Hot Coffee surrounding GTA: San Andreas saw Rockstar owner Take-Two paying out money to settle suits related to a mod in GTA: San Andreas’ PC edition that unlocked an interactive sex minigame .
As of yet, there is no indication that any sex scenes in GTA 6 would be interactive.
Also in the interview, Nelson discussed Jason and Lucia's relationship generally, saying players will be able to "role-play" their relationship, and "it's amazing."

GTA 6's story is narratively structured around Jason and Lucia, and the two of them working together. They don't have to be a couple, though, and instead can be simply "partners in crime" who are not romantically involved.

"I don’t want to say too much more about this because I don’t want to spoil anything. It really adds a compelling element to things, and it’s one of the reasons we wanted to approach this sort of story, because it's completely different for us," he said. "Could we bring some sort of emotional resonance to GTA for people if they wanted to engage with it? Could we also provide mechanisms for people to just opt out of it if they're not into it? If they feel like, ‘I don't want a relationship in this?’ That's what we're going to find out. It's not something that we want to foist upon players."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Jason_and_Lucia_09-3.jpg?w=636

Nelson went on to say GTA 6 will not give players "a particular gameplay benefit" if they have Jason and Lucia become lovers, however. But they will always have the benefit of "working together and having each other's back," he said.

"Whether they're romantically close or not doesn't change that. They will still work together. It's really about what you want for them, their story, and how it plays out. Whether you've nurtured the relationship or not will definitely have a bearing on how their story plays out," Nelson explained.

GTA 6 has a dedicated "relationship system" that is separate from a different gameplay system that tracks what sort of a criminal you are, Nelson said. Players can nurture the relationship between Jason and Lucia in the ways you would expect, including spending time together with things like kayaking and mini-golf. Or they can grow their relationship by robbing stores together.
"However players want to spend that time together, it will have a positive impact on the relationship," he said.

GTA 6's narrative setup has been likened to Bonnie and Clyde, the famous real-world criminal couple who met their end in a hail of gunfire . Many are wondering if both Jason and Lucia will make it out alive in GTA 6, or at the least, how their relationship may be tested. Another popular fan theory is that either Jason or Lucia is actually working with the Feds and will turn on the other at some point.
it won't be much longer until we find out, as GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

狠活还得看你。
尽管我体验过许多射击游戏，也浅尝过一些注重策略的二游。但迄今为止，我还没有见过任何一部射击游戏作品，能让玩家“身临其境”，跟那些活灵活现的二次元角色并肩作战，还能指挥她们、给她们下命令，一同庆祝胜利的喜悦。
我也没想到，是《暗区突围》这部搜打撤游戏最终实现了这一点。
9月30日，《暗区突围》和《少女前线2》联动上线，除了实装一批外观，也有对应的 玩法设计 。在前不久上线的指挥官模式中，玩家可以分别将OTs-14（别称“黑闪电”）、可露凯这两位联动角色编入小队，在局内指挥她们战斗。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/7e453e73419d9f18788073d10f43dba1.appmsg_mw680water
可露凯是少前人气最高的角色之一
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/ebc299571db496768ce86ed03d47ba95.appmsg_mw680water
为OTs-14指定目标地点投掷燃烧弹
这样的体验真的像是少前世界观下的“战术人形”并肩作战，为我和不少玩家带来了前所未有的新鲜感和陪伴感。
而少前联动并不是《暗区突围》这个赛季整出的唯一狠活。自9月2日暗区第19赛季上线以来，集中在游戏性和内容玩法层面的更新频次很高、力度也大，先后推出了“硬核模式2.0”“指挥官模式”，还有一套衍生的休闲卡牌玩法“暗区：封锁线”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/4a113e385b9d7dfc2986f33a87674108.appmsg_mw680water
对的，现在玩家们可以在一部搜打撤游戏里打牌了。 硬核模式好歹算是对搜打撤硬核原教旨的忠实还原，指挥官模式也可以说是暗区主模式的外延产物。可是卡牌玩法，乍一看怎么都和搜打撤不沾边——
然而正是这些“有的没的”，跟少前联动一样起到了正面作用，也让暗区在S19的讨论热度持续上升，乃至有一批玩其他卡牌的玩家专门下载暗区准备“炸鱼”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/eae5a01bc31f4598be536af6254f2594.appmsg_mw680water
七麦数据显示，《暗区突围》在9月30日位列iOS畅销榜第8名
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/9cdf845c913d9146d5792ce34d2710f9.appmsg_mw680water
我们常说一部游戏不可能取悦所有人，对于天生自带硬核门槛的搜打撤而言尤甚。不过作为品类先驱者，《暗区突围》似乎研究出了一套满足不同生态位用户诉求的“整活”策略。
在射击游戏里打牌
暗区S19狠活频出，其中反响最热烈的就是打牌玩法 “暗区：封锁线” ，玩起来既容易上手又容易上头。
规则和常见的回合制卡组构建玩法类似，玩家要从指挥官、士兵卡、武器卡、命令牌等四大类型的卡牌中挑选构建自己的卡组，在对战中利用卡组获取优势，清空对方指挥官的血量，或是让对方牌库枯竭持续扣血。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/cf26c28592817ef460d65fc50d172100.appmsg_mw680water
这套玩法的深度，有一部分来源于阵线机制和武器系统的配合。
场上划分了三条阵线，包括敌我指挥官身处的行动区，以及战场中间的封锁区。装备步枪和狙击枪的单位，可以跨阵线攻击；装备手枪、冲锋枪和霰弹枪的单位，只能攻击邻近阵线的敌方单位，需要积极“上线”争抢封锁区。士兵卡一般自带武器，而武器卡可以给指挥官装备，带来额外的攻击次数和场面变数。
另一部分深度来源于丰富的词条和技能。首先武器本身就有衍生效果，像霰弹枪能一打多，而狙击枪不会遭到反击。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/a71e82d76ebe14d1db475af7fc76809c.appmsg_mw680water
然后是各种词条，效果很好理解，稍微接触过这类回合制卡牌对战的玩家，更是一眼就懂：“部署”就是上场触发效果的“战吼”，“成盒”就是死后触发效果的“亡语”，“掩护”是给相邻友军单位开嘲讽扛伤害，“双发”是一回合打两次，“防弹”是默认数值减伤……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/4bc72cb93de176f6861aeebb7e89c8fa.appmsg_mw680water
词条一览
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/d81bdb6f33123178bb67ddce1f22e9e0.appmsg_mw680water
门岗战神有“猛攻”加持，打出后可立即行动，适合前期快攻
指挥官和很大一部分单位拥有特殊技能，而命令牌也有如上Buff、解单位、直接攻击敌人指挥官等强力效果。由于打出卡牌要耗费行动点，指挥官技能又需要每回合留些行动点充能，所以这套玩法的实质还是拼卡牌性价比，即如何用最少的费用打出最好的效果。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/e2741761b15cb2dc55db1b463c115cc4.appmsg_mw680water
托兰德技能是获取额外行动点，适合跳费打后期
为了让新手熟悉这套颇有深度的规则，游戏一上来会预设5套新手卡组。后续充实卡牌库存的过程，也在制造一条由浅入深的上手链路，打牌打输了也没啥惩罚，试错成本只有时间。
显然它非常适合填补碎片化时间，在频繁跑图略感疲惫的时候，满足休闲和放松的需求。 待到未来官方添加更多样化的卡牌、社区对卡组流派的理解完全成型，这套“暗牌”有成为《暗区突围》最耐玩衍生玩法的潜力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14479/5227d103851b830ad3cddd92fe522a40.appmsg_mw680water
“暗牌”推出后，官方也跟另一款卡牌游戏KARDS展开了友好互动
搜打撤的进化
在“暗牌”打响自己的名号之余，暗区没有忘记自己作为搜打撤FPS的本分， S19推出的指挥官模式和“硬核模式2.0”，均是对主体搜打撤玩法的深化。
指挥官模式允许玩家扮演指挥官，通过内置轮盘或语音指挥AI小队战斗，完成对局的搜打撤循环。
除少前联动限定的指挥官外，其余指挥官均为暗区世界观下的重要NPC，各自携带一支由AI士兵组成的队伍。队伍具备不同的装备配置与能力，对应NPC在剧情中的指挥战斗风格，适配不同玩家的游戏取向。
像阿贾克斯的“卫士”小队，携带盾牌稳步推进，注重防御。
多斯的小弟不擅长战斗，但是拥有四处搜刮并带回高价值物资的能力，擅长偷吃。
直接吃，快来吃，美滋滋
完成一批成长任务，还会升级小弟的装备和能力，变相提升撤离成功率。
这些小弟同样听从玩家的语音指挥，执行一些简单命令，从掩护、跟随、进攻，再到扫荡地图上的特定点位和房间。说句题外话，魔方工作室的AI语音指挥技术于2024年曝光，两年后在暗区的指挥官模式中落地，实现的效果却不同凡响。
所谓“指挥”不单单限定于游戏预设的指令清单，我还可以打开语音下一些比较复杂的命令，比如“在前面的树下警戒”“消灭别墅的敌人”“扫荡黄卡房”等。
至少证明了AI小弟真的忠诚
事实上，这套AI系统正在让许多未曾深入接触AI的玩家们钻研prompt（提示词）。例如“进攻”和“推进”两个指令就有区别，像阿贾克斯的持盾小弟，在“进攻”时会卸下盾牌鲁莽冲锋，但在收到“推进”指令时就会举盾稳步移动。再比如，很多人不明白如何让患有多动症的AI静步——但这首先需要指挥官/玩家以身作则，自己不露脚步才行。
AI语音指挥和指挥官模式的小队战斗相得益彰，强化了传统搜打撤玩法的策略性，靠AI小队的战斗博弈营造了有趣的差异化体验。可以想象，倘若AI技术继续发展下去，能为《暗区突围》乃至整个品类带来怎样的玩法进化。
同时暗区也在重现原汁原味的搜打撤体验，推出“硬核模式2.0”。
这个模式类似“怀旧服”，专为老玩家与核心玩家准备，大幅回调甚至提升游戏难度，去除了一系列辅助机制，包括地图、投掷物辅助线、准星和命中反馈等。不过在通过集中资源点鼓励玩家战斗的同时，硬核模式容器数量和爆率并不低，符合玩家对难度与奖励的综合预期。
包括卡牌玩法在内，S19推出的这一系列“狠活”，是想取悦不同层次和取向的玩家。
像硬核模式和指挥官模式，能够承接搜打撤品类不同生态位用户的需求，前者为最核心的那批玩家服务，而后者更强调策略博弈，允许玩家自行寻找适合自己的最优打法。至于衍生的卡牌玩法，能够满足碎片化的场景需求，吸引各路休闲玩家驻足体验。
总体而论，这些玩法诠释对玩家群体实现了分层覆盖的精准内容布局——而暗区所表现出的这种倾向，其实已经持续许久了。
硬核与休闲，可以兼顾
S19的扩圈倾向是对前几个赛季更新思路的继承和延伸。 今年以来，《暗区突围》一边打磨主体搜打撤模式，另一边也按照赛季更新的节奏，持续推出对休闲玩家而言十分友好的新玩法。
单是PVE玩法，暗区就“狠活”频出，例如在S17，推出大战怪物和伪人队友的微恐题材PVE合作玩法“诡雾山谷”；
其实很难说伪人和敌对真人玩家谁更恐怖

news.title: 没别人会像《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》这样做战棋了
news.summary: 9月28日，在第三方通关时间统计网站“How Long to Beat”上，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》终于有了首个“全破”通关纪录，全长120小时。此时距离游戏发售已经过了11天，该网站上其余7条记录也十分接近，只有一位连续

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/3e3c19d31eef3cb235be7fe5daed5fba.appmsg_mw680water
9月28日，在第三方通关时间统计网站“How Long to Beat”上，《火焰纹章：万缕千丝》终于有了首个“全破”通关纪录，全长120小时。此时距离游戏发售已经过了11天，该网站上其余7条记录也十分接近，只有一位连续三次跳过了战争篇的玩家，将通关时间压到了74小时，成为唯一一个不满90小时的纪录。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/2bef20065b116014e94424c9021037fb.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/02ac6bc1c11d584e99d499ad1e1ef772.appmsg_mw680water
目前公开的全流程视频长度也和网站上的记录相似
我自己的体验也差不多。游玩近两周、总时长达到30小时后，我才把四条路线之一的迪托利希线推进到第二部“战争篇”。这显然只能算阶段性成果。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/f1024824f94dca7402daf59df8931b18.appmsg_mw680water
《万缕千丝》给人的第一印象就是一个朴素的“长”——真的应了“万缕千丝”这个标题，也长到恐怕再没另一家公司会像这样来做战棋游戏了。
《万缕千丝》之所以长，首先来自剧情结构。创建自捏主角“救世主”后，玩家很快会得知魔神复活、世界濒临毁灭的坏消息。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/f32b330e1beeedc0437b4e199c4d3f55.gif_mw680
顺带一提，光是序章就出现了激光炮大战丧尸巨人的超现实场面
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/87bfd4f8fd26416891fe27dcf8a29395.appmsg_mw680water
还真不是
此时，游戏允许玩家带着仅三人的初始队伍直接进入游戏第三部，在跳过绝大多数故事、出战名额不齐的状态下挑战敌人大军。但这更像一条为战棋老手准备的高难速通挑战：战斗强度高、容错低，还会让玩家错过绝大部分剧情。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/c92e885a68d438fdbab355c52ad95a72.appmsg_mw680water
只靠三名角色想要挑战魔神大军，少不了用到卡位、算刀等技巧
真正承载完整故事的，则是另一条路：借女神之力回到过去，救下四位原本必死的关键角色，并让他们成为同伴。
这条“逆转未来”的主线，按游玩流程又分成第一部和第二部。第一部中，四名角色为了各自的目的前往王城“鞑古席翁”，参加大型斗技比赛“大剑斗祭”。到了第二部“战争篇”，幕后黑手的布局已经完成，几名主角与各自的同伴不得不投身战场，抵抗帝国大军的入侵。能在战争中存活下来的角色，也就改变了自己必死的命运，在第三部成为自创角色“救世主”的助力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/51c2d66f3105c12e68cd2f81a1c195d1.appmsg_mw680water
四条路线在叙事上的差异来自视角切换。每名角色只能看到自己身份和立场所能接触到的部分，玩家也因此在不同路线中看到“大剑斗祭”的不同侧面。
从流程上看，每条路线起始都有一段约两小时的专属序章，用来交代角色身份、经历和参赛动机。以黑衣剑客迪托利希为例，他出海时船只被怪物“海王克托斯”击沉，上岸后又结识了几名新同伴。一行人希望在大剑斗祭中崭露头角，赢得传说中坚不可摧的“鞑古扎战船”，再与海怪一决胜负。
另一位主角凯伊出身村庄，目标则更直接：赢下大剑斗祭，把被关进大牢的父亲赎出来。
由于序章的内容长、战斗多，几名角色很快升到10级，却还停留在成长率最低的初始职业，让我一度有种“是不是亏了”的感觉。但第三部展示的五年后剧情里，“救世主”一行等级已经达到40级，这也让我意识到本作的成长跨度很大，和后面的成长空间相比，前面几级的得失就没有那么让人焦虑了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/c5cb20c0b43381624c041f8ec85932e6.appmsg_mw680water
第三部初始的40级在以往的《火纹》作品中，基本已经是后期或者终盘的等级了
四条路线在叙事上的差异，主要体现在主视角不同：每条线基本只展开当前主角能够接触到的信息。即便四人陆续抵达王城“鞑古席翁”，这种有限视角也没有消失，同一场“大剑斗祭”会在不同路线中呈现出不同侧面；其赛程则让不同路线的角色在固定节点产生交集。
我在一条线里看到没交代清楚的冲突后，会想知道另一条线在同一时间发生了什么。而若想完整了解四条线的故事，少不了将四名角色各自的第一部和第二部全都玩一遍。
剧情之外，游戏还在每段主线之间加入大量生活化玩法。这些战斗外内容原本就是《风花雪月》在战棋之外吸引新玩家的重要部分；到了《万缕千丝》，它们不仅被保留下来，野外探索的比重也明显提高。
大剑斗祭的间隙，玩家可以在鞑古席翁城内请客吃饭、训练、挖角，也可以前往城外的节点式世界地图。本作的地图由棋盘式的节点组成，横跨多个地区，玩家按回合移动推进，逐步解锁新的区域。在这个过程中还能获得招募角色所需的特定素材，或是从商人手里购入强力武器，解锁影响后续剧情的关键外传等等。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/b32c567ba54288f56efdff1ebbfb8f68.appmsg_mw680water
该作的大地图庞大而复杂
平心而论，这些“通马桶”环节的确占用了不少时间，一些活动还需要定期回城处理，在城外掐着点跑来跑去时也难免有些焦虑。不过和《风花雪月》相比，本作四线日常流程的差异更加明显。
迪托利希作为战斗狂，其特殊玩法是使用魔剑“安萨拉”寻找潜在强敌并向他们发起挑战。路线约束相对较少，因此游玩相对自由，何时搜索、是否交战、向哪边推进都由玩家决定。加之地图离主城越远，敌人越强、奖励越高，因此我会不断向远端探索，临近时限再回城处理日常。
我朋友对凯伊线的感受则完全不同：几乎一直忙个不停，很少能空出手来出远门。凯伊的大地图玩法是捕捉鸵鸟、马等坐骑，再用野菜等素材喂养并提高属性。为了获得足够的素材，他还需要在资源点种植种子，并定期回来收菜。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/af3cf9535e6c02a6f7cda97e6f11eacb.appmsg_mw680water
游戏中还有一些能力强又稀有的特殊坐骑
这部分还反哺了战棋玩法。
凯伊线捕获的稀有坐骑既能提高对应角色的属性，也能提高其成长率。因此常常变成全员骑兵的配置。
女王赛奥朵拉线又提供了另一套思路。她可以为角色配备军团并释放对应计略，但这一系统只适用于步兵。因此她的养成重点自然落在步兵身上，与凯伊线正好相反。
这些差异让四条路线的日常与养成不至于完全重样；但大剑斗祭的赛程终究要经历四次，于是游戏又加入了跨路线继承，让后续路线在重复环节上“越打越快”。
完成任意一名角色的路线后，玩家就可以带队伍进入第三部，直接和“救世主”一起挑战最终Boss。不过，如果转而开启其他角色路线，就能吃到跨路线继承带来的“红利”。
不同路线都有需要在本线满足条件才能获得的隐藏职业。例如，骑鸵鸟的“飞驼兵”可以转职为“神驼兵”，但这条职业路径需要在凯伊线解锁；其他路线只有继承该要素后，才能使用神驼兵。类似这种隐藏职业，每条路线都有不少。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14481/f570bd6975835f9c9e058e2dcb15b734.appmsg_mw680water
兼具高物防和魔防的隐藏职业“卫士”
除去隐藏职业外，当任意路线的第一部完成后，前一位角色探索过的地图节点，包括可以用来快速移动的马车站点，也会一并继承给后续路线；通用的支线任务也会自动完成。对玩家来说，后续路线的跑图压力会明显减轻，可以把更多时间留给角色养成。
因此，社区也常讨论先走哪条线更合适。
更值得注意的是，《万缕千丝》目前的体量，已经是经历过一次明显缩减后的结果。
除去四条线路的主角外，在游戏中还有着四位明显有着“主角相”的角色：比如神秘商人谭利穆恩的名字出现在不少NPC的对话中，让人能感觉到他也在一点点推进自己的计划；戴猫面具的少女欧露赫露则在一次战斗中展露真容，其面貌与传说中的女神完全一致；武艺超群的“白发鬼”贝特兰每次出场都会成为事件的焦点。
这几位角色的关键剧情有专属的过场动画
这些角色在战场上也都各自拥有专属的“圣焰战技”，与四条路线的主角一样，在剧情中被称为“真焰使”。
发售前的官方采访也提到，该作最初计划设置八名主角，后来因体量过大缩减为四人。
但即使是大幅缩减后的体量，依旧能打个一百小时。
结语
所以，再回看开头“How Long to Beat”的那几条通关记录，这个时长也不难理解了。
《万缕千丝》把四条角色线装进同一个存档，让完整体验的内容量接近四个独立篇章。游戏的确允许玩家跳过部分路线，但面对完整的剧情、隐藏职业和外传内容，想看全的玩家未必舍得走捷径。
我目前只推进到战争篇，暂时没法判断这种长度最终是享受还是负担。但至少“它很大”这一点，现在已经不需要怀疑了。

news.title: The Next Gears Of War Game Probably Won’t Need 7 Years To Cook
news.summary: After a lengthy hiatus, Gears of War returned this week to Xbox Series X|S and PC with a new adventure set dur

content.v: After a lengthy hiatus, Gears of War returned this week to Xbox Series X|S and PC with a new adventure set during the cataclysmic events of Emergence Day. For fans of the series, it has been a long wait, as the previous entry in the series, Gears 5 , was released all the way back in 2019. Will there be another seven-year stretch between new Gears games? Gears of War: E-Day developer The Coalition doesn't think so, as the new game lays the groundwork for a quicker turnaround for new potential chapters in the IP.

Speaking to the BBC , Coalition studio head Mike Crump said that E-Day provides a "great foundation" for future games, and he claimed that "the next game will not take nearly as long" to make. "What I say to myself, what I say to the team, is we just we need to focus on the things that we can control. For us that's about shipping a great game that people are going to love and I feel like, as a team, we've done that," Crump added in response to questions about the safety of the studio and its institutional knowledge during a period of mass layoffs at Xbox. "We've got a great team here. And the leadership team in particular has worked together for upwards of 20 years. So there's definitely a continuity of knowledge and experience."
So far, The Coalition appears to have been spared the brunt of " Xbox reset " layoffs, but fears remain that the axe might swing their way now that Gears of War: E-Day has launched.

Recent changes at Xbox have seen several studios consolidated under Bethesda and Activision, and even Xbox's high-profile Halo series has not been spared. After being under the remit of Halo Studios for several years, a new team at Activision is now developing the next Halo game, rumored to be a new division within Call of Duty developer Sledgehammer Games.

The future of the Gears of War series likely rests with its commercial performance, but as an Xbox exclusive, there's only so much room for sales before you factor in its availability as a day-one Xbox Game Pass release and its launch during a crowded period on the gaming calendar. Crump sees things differently, believing the true measure of E-Day's success will be its ability to move the needle for Xbox and show what the gaming brand is capable of as it enters a new era, not just sales numbers.

"We measure things like, are we showcasing the platform? Are we pushing the hardware to its limits? Are we showcasing what the Xbox is capable of? Our goal basically is to be the best-looking game on the Xbox and really show the industry what's possible with our hardware," Crump said.

news.title: Gears of War: E-Day Studio Boss Insists 'The Next Game Will Not Take Nearly as Long' to Make, Responds to Layoff Concern
news.summary: The boss of Gears of War: E-Day developer The Coalition has responded to reports that staff at the studio are

content.v: The boss of Gears of War: E-Day developer The Coalition has responded to reports that staff at the studio are worried they will lose their jobs amid the ongoing cuts at Xbox, and promised the next Gears game won’t take as long to make.

Earlier this month, Eurogamer reported on serious internal concern that layoffs would hit The Coalition after the release of E-Day. "The mood is certainly 'let's not celebrate the game until we're three months post launch, just in case,' which is very unusual," one source told the site. "We're just expecting the next wave [of layoffs], or being reorganized under Activision or something later this year," claimed another.

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s “reset” of Microsoft’s gaming business has seen nearly 2,000 people cut already this financial year, with more to come. A number of studios have left the business or are in the process of closing down. Microsoft has also reorganized its studios, bringing Halo and Sea of Thieves developer Rare under Call of Duty developer Activision, and Grounded developer Obsidian under Fallout developer Bethesda.

The Coalition has, for the most part, avoided the cuts, although E-Day's story director was laid off just one week before the game's early access launch . The BBC put Eurogamer’s report to The Coalition studio head Mike Crump, who danced around the issue in his response.
"What I say to myself, what I say to the team, is we need to focus on the things that we can control,” Crump said.
"For us that's about shipping a great game that people are going to love and I feel like, as a team, we've done that."

No guarantee, then, that The Coalition will escape the fate suffered by so many at Xbox this summer. But Crump did suggest there are plans for more Gears of War games. He called E-Day a "great foundation" for future games in the series, and said "the next game will not take nearly as long" to make.

As for what the next Gears game is, in June 2024, Microsoft pledged to continue the story of Gears of War and wrap up the cliffhanger posed by Gears 5's ending, despite creating a prequel first with E-Day. The question is, will The Coalition get the chance to make it?

news.summary: 浙江湖州一位老人将31.56克金手镯两次以旧换新后仅剩17.97克，13.5克黄金凭空消失

content.v: 浙江湖州一位老人将31.56克金手镯两次以旧换新后仅剩17.97克，13.5克黄金凭空消失，店家以品牌更换、系统变更为由无法提供中间换货的关键单据。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_19/175.jpg
2014年在湖州一家金店（原老庙黄金，现更名金大福）购入千足金手镯，重31.56克。2019年或2021年首次以旧换新后克重已缩至约18克；2026年4月再次换新时，单据显示旧料仅重17.97克。累计减少约13.5克黄金，按当前金价估算价值超一万元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_19/1203.jpg
老人被引导将按克计价的旧金换成了“一口价”黄金首饰，后者按标价而非克重销售，工艺溢价高但实际含金量低。换购时店员未主动告知新镯克重，也未说明重量会大幅减少，只强调款式和工艺，老人因信任店家而未核实。
店方称操作属“同类换同类”，即按价格而非克重兑换，属于正常规则范畴。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_19/1341.jpg

content.v: 《沉星之序》是一部由传奇游戏制作人“吹哥”乔纳森·布洛（代表作《时空幻境》《见证者》）耗时10年打造的冒险解谜游戏，游戏即将于10月9日正式登陆Steam、NS2及PS5平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072253552101.jpg
今日，游戏媒体评测正式解禁，其首批媒体评价也已正式出炉。截至发稿，游戏在M站PC平台共收获7份媒体评测，均分86分。NS2平台5份媒体评测，均分85分。PS5平台7份媒体评测，均分83分。
部分媒体评测如下：
Shacknews：100/100
平台：PC
《沉星之序》是一款大师级作品。其无可挑剔、令人烧脑的谜题经过精心设计，能够让你先感到自己蠢得无以复加，随后又产生前所未有的聪明感。游戏世界彼此紧密相连，层层揭示并逐步引入各种机制，再加上通关后的延续内容，使其成为终极推箱子游戏体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072254155589.png
Nintenduo：90/100
平台：NS2
凭借自身的野心，以及将各种机制与游戏世界巧妙融合为一个庞大而完整谜题的精湛技艺，《沉星之序》已经成为解谜游戏领域的标杆之一。这是一款真正独特、设计精妙的作品，唯一的不足在于Switch 2的性能表现未能达到应有水平。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072254222758.png
GamingTrend：90/100
平台：PS5
《沉星之序》中拥有数量惊人的优秀多层次谜题，因此它花费10年时间才最终面世，我并不感到意外。游戏可能会频繁出现阻碍玩家推进的难题，如果无法理解某些机制，体验也会变得极其苛刻。但当所有要素最终串联起来、玩家恍然大悟的那一刻到来时，这种感觉是其他游戏无法带来的。我认为，这些令人陶醉的时刻足以让漫长的等待完全值得。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072254297334.png
GameSpot：80/100
平台：PC
如果《沉星之序》在数量庞大的谜题安排上能够更加精心取舍，整体表现或许会更好，但偶尔出现的挫败感和过度复杂的问题，也是为了能够体验如此多有趣创意而需要付出的、完全可以接受的代价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072254367300.png
PSX Brasil：80/100
平台：PS5
为了打造《沉星之序》，制作组获得了其他开发者制作的4款推箱子风格游戏的授权，并将它们编织成4个篇章，最终组成一个规模庞大且极具巧思的整体。然而，这种前所未有的规模也成为游戏叙事和解谜体验上的一个弱点，因为它有时会让人感到难以应付、令人困惑且过于庞杂。
即便如此，这款游戏仍然能够吸引两类截然不同的玩家：一类玩家愿意投入数百小时，挖掘游戏中的每一处细节；另一类玩家则只想在自己感兴趣的时候享受谜题，而不介意自己可能只能体验游戏庞大内容中的一小部分——即便如此，这也可能意味着数十小时的游戏时间。

news.title: Google Playground Wants Everyone To Make AI Games, And Maybe Everyone Shouldn’t
news.summary: Stadia might be dead , but Google isn't giving up on gaming. The company has rolled out Playground , a platfor

content.v: Stadia might be dead , but Google isn't giving up on gaming. The company has rolled out Playground , a platform built around AI that "lets you create, play, and share custom games." It's browser-based and labeled as an "experiment" to start. There's also Unity Spark support, which will offer more development options for people who catch the creator bug.

Google's pitch claims that this new platform makes game creation more democratic by ending gatekeeping to development. The company states that Playground "lowers the barriers to creation, so bringing game ideas to life can now be as easy as describing it through a few prompts--no coding experience required." The platform also feels like the company's attempt at taking a piece of the Roblox pie--something that Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reportedly wants with Minecraft , too.

However, the initial rollout feels pretty underwhelming. The most hilarious part of the Playground experience, so far, is realizing how misleading the cover art for games is after actually playing them. For example, we checked out Volcano Run. The key image shows a sports car racing around a road crumbling; meanwhile, the actual gameplay is a rudimentary rectangular motorcycle (we think) driving in a Tron-like environment.

One of the Unity Spark highlights is called Horror Story, and the game starts with players following a ghost into a haunted house. How that ghost shuffles into the residence is one of the funnier animations we've witnessed in a game recently.

The most promising experience we checked out was Steampunk Match, a match-3 puzzle game. Players need to create combos to stop a boiler from exploding. This game felt much better than others that attempted to take a swing at the action-RPG genre, such as Catacombs.

If you are looking to make your own game for Playground, that opportunity is apparently rolling out to people "soon." However, Google says people can upgrade their Google One plan to get started immediately.

news.title: 《战争机器：事变日》单人战役 Fami 通评测：恐慌感与绝望感回归
news.summary: 不知不觉已经来到 10 月，再过阵子就是 TGA 然后就是年底了，真是岁月如梭啊！简直像是恐怖游戏一样。每当我切身感受到人会这样一天天老去，就下定决心要好好珍惜每一天，去玩更多的游戏。 今天要为大家介绍的作品，是 Xbo

content.v: 不知不觉已经来到 10 月，再过阵子就是 TGA 然后就是年底了，真是岁月如梭啊！简直像是恐怖游戏一样。每当我切身感受到人会这样一天天老去，就下定决心要好好珍惜每一天，去玩更多的游戏。
今天要为大家介绍的作品，是 Xbox 旗下的招牌 IP 之一《战争机器》系列的最新作《战争机器：事变日》。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/9f467930f23ec28c485767e2963a4816/
见证绝望战争的开端
本作将会讲述发生在初代《战争机器》14 年前的前传故事。彼时人类之间争夺资源的战争刚刚告一段落，还没等喘口气，神秘势力兽族便突然从地底涌出，导致人类瞬间蒸发了 25% 的人口。《战争机器：事变日》将会深入描绘这场漫长战争的开端，也就是“事变日”来领之后几天内的故事。
这几天的战斗氛围简直太令人绝望了。人类几乎毫无还手之力，一直处于被动挨打或者四处逃窜的状态，简直像是在观看一部科幻惊悚恐怖片。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/4ac70213c8bb79453730282a6c8faab1/
本作支持单人游玩或最多 4 人合作游玩。四位主角团的成员分别是一提到《战争机器》系列就绕不开的硬汉马库斯·菲尼克斯、他的死党多姆·圣提亚哥、前士兵马格斯·卡特以及新兵卢卡斯·雷耶斯。这 4 个人将共同组成 B 小队，携手把兽族揍得满地找牙。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/efae80e94e68da12c672e9e2355f437e/
其中最令人激动的，莫过于马库斯和多姆的日语配音依旧由《战争机器》1~3 代的声优广田行生先生和高阶俊嗣先生负责。因此这对最强搭档之间的各种斗嘴互动也都得到了保留，对于系列老粉丝们而言，单凭这一点就绝对值得一玩。
顺带一提，那句经典台词“Plan B”也会再次登场。玩家甚至能在游戏内亲眼见证作为《战争机器》代名词的武器“骑兵突击步枪”的原型是如何诞生的，令人欲罢不能。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/1cec89fc8882ca399fdeb85bf89ae523/
在系列旧作基础上的稳步进化
游戏依然沿用了 TPS 的基础玩法，玩家需要熟练运用掩体系统躲避在墙壁等障碍物后，不断击退眼前涌现的兽族。
说到本作的掩体系统，游戏不仅会根据障碍物的高度自动切换角色的站立和半蹲状态，哪怕障碍物被敌人破坏，角色也能动作流畅地顺势倒下，以仰卧的姿势继续躲藏在掩体后。两套动作之间的衔接过渡十分自然，光是看着都有种莫名的爽快感，甚至让人想没事就多试几次。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/58a14f8a3d72ef394003de206020644c/
随着战况恶化不断发生改变的战场
游戏的舞台设置在锡拉星上的城市卡洛娜及其近郊。初期流程和系列此前的作品一样都是线性关卡，但到了游戏的后期，玩家将会来到更加开放的市中心区域和港口区域。
随着剧情的推进与战局的不断恶化，一开始还保留着些许城市风貌的街道将逐渐变成人间地狱，无数大楼倒塌，人类的尸体散落一地。话说回来，这也意味着开发团队需要为同一个地区制作多个状态的版本，工作量相当惊人。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/14c44f1af3891e245561eda990d6adce/
节奏紧凑的开放区域
进入开放区域之后，玩家只需要移动到地图上显示的目标地点即可推进剧情。但在此过程中，如果你选择去周围的建筑或小巷中探索一番，也能完成一些支线目标或发现收藏品。
就笔者的个人感受而言，《战争机器 4》和《战争机器 5》的开放区域因为总是需要长途跋涉，所以很容易让人觉得有点拖沓。但本作却并非如此，战斗场景十分密集，虽然引入了开放区域的设计，但却依旧保持了 1~3 代那种紧凑的推进节奏，这一点非常棒。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/aa7827b69c9cc36f32b69d9451ce41f7/
此外，游戏在敌人的兵力配置上也做了很好的平衡，不会让玩家在中途就感受到枯燥乏味。每次遭遇新的战斗，你都会收获不同的体验。顺带一提，和 Boss 级别的敌人交手时玩家面临的都是一场场硬仗，千万不能掉以轻心。
令人热血沸腾的收集和武器改造系统
在关卡中探索时，玩家可以找到市民或其他士兵留下的遗物，以及可以用来改造武器的“硬派箱”。
前者通常是补充世界观设定和主要角色背景故事的收集要素，而后者则是能够提升武器性能或改变其特性的强力配件。因此我个人还是强烈建议大家不要只顾着推进主线任务，还是要到各处去探索一下。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/2cdf09f057cb865f15184b1bbcec215c/
话虽如此，这些可收集物品大多都放置在玩家的行动路线附近。当你靠近这些物品时，不仅会响起系列经典的提示音，也会直接在地图上标示着大致的位置，玩家甚至还能利用扫描功能来进行定位。所以探索时完全不用着急，只要慢慢缩小范围，最终都能找到。
开启“战术通信”视角不仅能确认队友的位置，还会显示收集要素所在的地点，推荐大家多多使用
接下来重点介绍一下武器改装系统。除了开启硬派箱外，完成支线任务同样可以获得改装配件。玩家可以前往分布在地图各处的补给箱处安装配件。通过改造枪械、护甲和战术装备，可以获得诸如扩充弹匣容量、提供子弹散布精度等各种增益。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/c9a7231b5aab30bfbce54cba50c79c23/
其中我个人最爱的是能为《战争机器》系列中极具人气的武器“纳许霰弹枪”换上独头弹的配件。
默认配置的纳许霰弹枪虽然子弹散布比较大，但在近距离往往拥有出毁天灭地的威力。而换上独头弹之后，即便是中距离的敌人，只要能打中对方的躯干中心，也能实现一击必杀。拿着这把武器把如潮水般用来的杂兵兽族一个个轰碎，简直不要太爽！每把武器都拥有各式各样的自定义选项，因此改造出一把最合自己心意的武器也是本作的一大乐趣所在。
绝佳的系列入门作
笔者通关整个单人战役模式大概花了 13 个小时。虽然我选择的是普通难度，并且在通关过程中进行了一些探索，但游戏的体量我个人觉得还算是很充实了。而且提到《战争机器》，血腥表现绝对是得着重讲一讲的。从笔者玩到的 PC 版看来，本作依然延续了系列过去作品那种宛如“大屠杀”一般的尺度，能感受到开发团队完全没打算在这方面做任何妥协，这一点也值得点赞。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/7735414d3f8bcdb23f52b729fd26def6/
如果你是第一次接触《战争机器》系列，笔者强烈建议你在体验完《战争机器：事变日》之后，紧接着去游玩那个发生在 14 年后的初代《战争机器》重制版，然后再去了解该系列的其他作品。
如果你本就是该系列的老粉丝，那也请务必通过本作，亲自去感受一下事变日来临时的地狱景象，并深刻认识到人类为什么会被迫逃往贾辛图高原。
原作者：BRZRK 翻译：弹丸 编辑：熊猫命

news.title: Mafia 2 and Mafia 3 Could Be Set for PS5 and Xbox Series Upgrades After Definitive Editions Leak Online
news.summary: Mafia 2 and Mafia 3 are coming to PS5 and Xbox Series consoles with some prettier graphics, according to an ES

content.v: https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2016/06/12/mafia3-e3trailer02jpg-c1f474.jpg

Mafia 2 and Mafia 3 are coming to PS5 and Xbox Series consoles with some prettier graphics, according to an ESRB rating. Both games are rated Mature 17+ by the board, with each title featuring violence, nudity, and so… many… slurs.

Previously, Mafia: Definitive Edition released for modern consoles in September 2020. A full-blown, ground-up remake of the original 2002 game, it acted as a great starting point for people jumping into the series for the first time. Mafia 2 and 3 Definitive Editions already exist for the last-gen consoles, so these listings presumably relate to current-gen upgrades that will, hopefully, include 60fps gameplay, rather than full-blown remakes.

Publisher 2K recently released the Mafia: The Omertà Collection, which includes all the Definitive Editions alongside Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition. This launched alongside a PS5 and Xbox Series update to Mafia: Definitive Edition that seems likely to be replicated for Mafia 2 and 3.

Interest in the series is at a new high following the release of Mafia: The Old Country earlier this year. A prequel story set at the height of the mob’s power in Italy, it followed the series’ template of plonking players into an open world that serves as a backdrop to the story, rather than a character in it.

IGN’s Mafia: The Old Country review scored it an 8/10, and called the game an “effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia 2.” Mafia 3 split critics at launch because it leaned into its open world and made players complete repeatable missions to capture territory and progress the story. Amazing soundtrack, though.

Hangar 13 president Nick Baynes previously told IGN that Mafia and GTA — despite sharing a parent company — exist in two separate camps. “I think that genuinely at the studio, we've got our own path,” Baynes said. “It genuinely never ever comes up in conversation as a touchpoint or steering our strategy or anything like that.”

The ESRB posting doesn’t give much away, besides rehashing themes you’d expect from a game series named after an organized crime group. It’ll be interesting to see which side of GTA 6 ’s release date this November these Definitive Editions end up. Because while the games are fairly different, the audience only has limited disposable income and that choice has probably already been made if the games land anywhere near each other.

IGN just put out a big GTA 6 interview with Rockstar North studio head Rob Nelson , in which we spoke to him as he played a section of the game in front of us. Nelson spoke about its approach to open world design, and creating a game where “just existing” is a viable playstyle, living in Vice City and playing it almost like a life simulator.

It’s a very different approach to Mafia, in which the open world is simply a backdrop to the story. Still, isn’t it great that we live in a world where both approaches are viable and we get to experience it all?

A Mafia 2 and Mafia 3: Definitive Edition announcement is likely imminent, either way. My best guess would be The Game Awards this December, with a launch early next year. While you wait to find out, check out IGN's in-depth feature, 25 Years of Mafia Video Games: An Oral History .

news.title: GTA 6 Won’t Make You “All-Powerful” Like GTA 5 Did
news.summary: Rockstar boss Rob Nelson has stated that GTA 6 won't make players "all-powerful" like they were in GTA 5 and t

content.v: Rockstar boss Rob Nelson has stated that GTA 6 won't make players "all-powerful" like they were in GTA 5 and the games that came before it. For GTA 6, this means NPCs in the world will have impulses of their own, and could come after you.

Speaking to IGN , Nelson said, "The world will act upon you as well as you acting upon the world." In previous GTA games, except for the police, the player was the only one with an "invisible arsenal hidden away," and everyone in the world would run away in terror. "This world in GTA 6 is not like that," he said.

Nelson went on to say that GTA 6's story, which follows the partners in crime and lovers Jason and Lucia, is about "criminals on the run." However, the game's narrative is such that they are incentized to "do what they need to do while not drawing unnecessary attention."

"So if you're doing things on a mission that you are required to do--or you’re robbing places, or somebody comes and messes with you and you have to deal with them by smacking them down or whatever--that’s all fair game," he said. "It's when you go beyond what is necessary on a consistent basis or you do completely unnecessary stuff consistently that you may start to sway your criminal profile in a certain direction. Maybe you care about that as a player, maybe you don't. There is no right or wrong way to play this."

Nelson said being "overpowered" as a character compared to everyone else except the cops "can be fun but not as fun" as a world in which other people may have "impulses of their own and act upon you."

"You are still powerful and capable, but you are not the only one capable of violence or the only one with weapons or the only crazy person out there," he said. "It makes the world far more unpredictable and interesting. It's something that we started doing in Red Dead Redemption 2, where you are not the only dangerous person in the world. There are gangs that will attack you, things that will happen to you. The world will act upon you. That happens here a lot, and then when it does, you have a decision to make. How do you want to deal with it?"

In GTA 6, the cops are getting upgrades, too. A new "heat" system means the police now know what the player looks like and what they're wearing, so even if players put on a hat or glasses, the cops still know who they are until they change clothes.

GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it's reportedly already sold close to 6 million copies. A recent report said the game might be available to stream in November, but that's apparently not the case .

news.title: 日本推出"回炉重生"桑拿房 模拟从妈妈子宫诞生
news.summary: 日本WIQOMEDIAN株式会社于2026年10月，在东京六本木开设男女均可使用的包间桑拿“SAUNA MOTHER”。其概念为“不做大人120分钟”。

content.v: 日本WIQOMEDIAN株式会社于2026年10月，在东京六本木开设男女均可使用的包间桑拿“SAUNA MOTHER”。其概念为“不做大人120分钟”。
顾客将依次体验以胎内为意象的桑拿、令人联想到新生儿沐浴的冷水浴池、把头枕在母亲膝上的淋浴，最后在“母亲沙发”上被拥抱、摇晃、抚摸、守望，进入桑拿后特有的深度放松状态“ととのい”。这是一处为容易失去心灵依托的现代成年人准备的空间，让他们暂时卸下大人身份，把一切交托出去。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/1213.jpg
母亲沙发特点1：被抱住
其结构从头到脚包裹使用者，形成身体各处不易承受多余力量的中立姿势，同时可像婴儿一样以C形曲线把全身交托出去。所有身体接触部位均采用SIXINCH公司的独家涂层材料，尽可能消除因硬度或疼痛而把意识从放松状态中拉回的因素。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/1339.jpg
母亲沙发特点2：被摇晃、被抚摸
母亲沙发并不只是外形像母亲的手臂。沙发本身会实际缓慢摇动，速度可从以下三档选择：
温和的母亲｜0.40Hz（2.5秒往返一次）
普通的母亲｜0.56Hz（1.8秒往返一次）
急性子的母亲｜0.71Hz（1.4秒往返一次）
这种摇动利用了哺乳类的“运输反应”习性：被父母搬运时副交感神经占优，强制进入放松状态。此外还结合轻柔抚摸身体的机构，接近被母亲哄抱时的感觉。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/1545.jpg
母亲沙发特点3：被守望
通过投影映射，母亲会出现在母亲沙发上。使用者可从以下“四种可选母亲”中选择一位，在其表情守望下、与之对视，把身体交托出去。
我们的母亲——伊邪那美：生下日本列岛与众神的原初母神，代表日本神话中不仅温柔、也包含敬畏的母性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/1673.jpg
似曾相识的二次元母亲：让人联想到日本人一定见过的某动画母亲形象，是令人怀念、安心的母亲。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/1720.jpg
被名画拥抱的艺术母亲：灵感来自雷诺阿、克里姆特、莫迪利亚尼等描绘母性的艺术表现，按时期更换。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/1769.jpg
世界母亲们——神话母亲：盖亚、伊西斯等世界神话中的母神，计划每周轮换登场。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/1809.jpg
拥抱、摇动、触觉、视线，这些并非单纯演出，而是基于被称为“爱情荷尔蒙”的催产素分泌机制设计。据称，被温柔抚摸或相互对视会促进催产素分泌，而催产素可抑制掌管压力与不安的大脑活动，给人带来“安心感”和“把自己交托出去的感觉”。

身体经桑拿极限热与冷水池寒冷大幅刺激自律神经后，在休息（放松）瞬间副交感神经占优，接近日常心理防御墙全部放下的“无防备状态”。在这个身心屏障解除的黄金时段，连续启动C形姿势、固定节奏摇动、柔软触觉、与母亲对视等“催产素开关”。由此产生超越普通放松的“可以完全把自己交托在这里”的绝对安心状态，像婴儿只有在母亲臂弯中才能获得，带来一种前所未有的沉浸感。目标是通桑拿与催产素结合，重构没有过去后悔、没有未来不安、“此时此地”连续存在的终极正念状态。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/11149.jpg
通往母亲沙发的各项设备也按照诞生流程构成。
桑拿房以象征生命的红光、再现胎内的声音、令人联想到母亲肌肤的香气，以及中高温多湿（85℃／40%）的大量出汗设定包裹使用者。当然可自助泼水。
子宫桑拿外侧设圆窗。还计划引入可摆出胎儿姿势的胎儿长椅，拍摄蜷缩姿态的“胎儿照”，并现场制作带照片的“再出生证明”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/11306.jpg
新生儿沐浴冷水浴池
桑拿后进入以新生儿沐浴为意象的深冷水浴池。它被再现新生儿模糊视野的帘幕包裹，设计上让人稍感自己变小，水深80厘米、水温15℃。墙壁中出现的巨大母亲之手会温柔地浇下“产汤”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/11407.jpg
不只世界观，作为桑拿也很认真
SAUNA MOTHER并非只追求奇拔或适合拍照打卡的设施。作为所有体验基础的桑拿质量也彻底追求。
温度、湿度、冷水池设定为讲究的“85×40×15”。85℃看似温和，但40%高湿可在不给身体造成负担的情况下促进大量出汗，是黄金设定基础。当然可通过自助泼水调成更合个人喜好的设定。冷水池为不过冷、但能充分冷却的最佳水温15℃。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/11590.jpg
在墙面材料方面，公司比较研究蓄热性与热辐射率后选定材料。桑拿房长椅大量使用西部红雪松。墙面则精密计算“蓄热力（蓄热性）”与“热辐射力（辐射率）”两项指标，只选用通过公司独自严格标准的材料。像在子宫内一样，追求整个面如包裹般的放热。与150厘米低天花板结合，可从胎儿般的脚尖到头顶均匀蒸热，无明显温差。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_14/11745.jpg
※本设施并非医疗机构，不保证催产素分泌及其他医学、心理效果。
设施概要
设施名：SAUNA MOTHER
所在地：东京都港区六本木7-10-30 Keepers六本木B1F
形式：仅一间、完全预约制包间桑拿、男女均可使用
使用人数：1〜4人
使用时间：120分钟

news.title: 玩家E评《皇牌空战8》：久违的畅快空战

content.v: #皇牌空战8-评测#
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_1755221_4863228.jpg
个人给予这部作品 9.0/10 分，属于 “ 强烈推荐 ” 的范畴。 这部《皇牌空战》系列的续作给到玩家久违的畅快空战体验，画质与战斗体验优秀，顶级的配乐恰到好处响起令人精神澎湃，人物建模也十分亮眼，虽然中后期堆怪过多且角色刻画不够深刻，但绝对是近几年能玩到的最好的空战游戏之一，空战爱好者一定不要错过。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_1755221_4863229.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_1755221_4863230.jpg
本作的画质有了全面提升，阳光穿过云层的效果极佳，地面建筑的数量与细致程度也令人惊讶。F-22在万米高空的高机动狗斗、F-15E在高楼之间穿梭的对地攻击，A-10火箭弹与机炮齐发舔地打爆一片油田等场景都持续刺激着玩家的肾上腺。游戏依旧提供了爽快的狗斗体验，机型与弹药种类众多，飞行与操控手感优秀，娱乐感极强又不失拟真，新老玩家都可以快速上手。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_1755221_4863231.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_1755221_4863232.jpg
本作的配乐堪称完美，许多歌曲都在恰当的时间响起，韵律动人，歌词完全匹配当时情景，令人汗毛倒竖，泪点低的玩家估计直接热泪盈眶。游戏的人物建模非常养眼，粉毛少女自不用说，其他角色也都是帅哥美女。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_1755221_4863233.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_1755221_4863234.jpg
不过，本作对于这些核心角色的刻画比较有限，CG里的戏剧冲突不够过瘾，日常无线电对话也主要是插科打诨，并没有深度构筑每个角色的背景与变化，导致玩家通关后对角色认知很少，有些浪费这么好看的建模。其次，游戏中后期堆怪过多，让玩家去打成百上千架敌方飞机有些过分了，简单模式下普通导弹数量无限还好，难度高一点弹药都要精打细算。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_1755221_4863235.jpg
#空战奇兵8僚机应援#

news.title: 曝Xbox新手柄采用霍尔摇杆!便宜好货御三家为啥不用
news.summary: 据IGN报道，Xbox精英无线手柄Series 3的相关信息近日疑似遭到泄露。根据曝光的配置文件，新款手柄或将针对摇杆、音量控制以及背键等…

content.v: 编辑观点： 看到Xbox精英无线手柄Series 3泄露疑似支持霍尔、TMR摇杆，我第一反应就是——御三家终于开始考虑了。
据IGN报道，Xbox精英无线手柄Series 3的相关信息近日疑似遭到泄露。根据曝光的配置文件，新款手柄或将针对摇杆、音量控制以及背键等方面进行升级。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072220123009.png
据称，新手柄将允许玩家在霍尔摇杆和TMR摇杆之间进行选择，同时加入音频滚轮，并提供更多不同样式的背键设计。
霍尔摇杆已经不是什么新技术，为什么索尼、微软、任天堂这些年依然大量使用传统碳膜摇杆？
此前就有相关讨论认为，霍尔摇杆增加的零件成本并没有想象中那么高，甚至有说法称单颗零件只增加约11.6元。对于玩家来说，自然很容易产生“多花十几块钱就能减少漂移，为什么不换”的疑问。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072220235034.png
但我觉得，这件事可能没那么简单。
首先，霍尔和碳膜摇杆的手感确实不同。阻尼、回弹、细微输入都会影响实际体验，用惯传统摇杆的玩家换成霍尔后，未必所有人都觉得更舒服。
所以如果Xbox精英3最终真的允许玩家自行选择摇杆方案，反而说明厂商也知道这不是简单的“新技术一定更好”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072220379555.png
其次就是大家最容易想到的商业考量。
手柄出现漂移后，玩家往往只有维修或者换新的选择。如果传统摇杆本身存在正常磨损，那么玩家购买新手柄自然会更加频繁。虽然目前没有证据证明御三家是为了卖手柄而故意不用霍尔，但站在玩家角度，这个疑问确实很难完全消失。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072221151286.png
你觉得御三家这么多年不用霍尔摇杆，更多是技术和手感上的取舍，还是商业考量？

news.title: 2026年诺贝尔化学奖揭晓!日法科学家获奖 破百年难题
news.summary: 快科技10月7日消息，今日，瑞典皇家科学院宣布，将2026年诺贝尔化学奖授予法国科学家亨利·B·卡根和日本科学家硖合宪三，以表彰他…

content.v: 快科技10月7日消息，今日，瑞典皇家科学院宣布，将2026年诺贝尔化学奖授予法国科学家亨利·B·卡根和日本科学家硖合宪三，以表彰他们在不对称有机合成中非线性效应和自催化方面的发现。
获奖者将平分1200万瑞典克朗（约合802万元人民币）奖金。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072220324315.jpg
简单来说，两人的研究解决了一个困扰化学界上百年的问题：为什么生命中的分子会“偏爱”某一个方向。
许多分子都有两种结构，它们就像人的左手和右手一样互为镜像，看起来非常相似，却无法完全重合，这种特性被称为“手性”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072220434968.png
奇怪的是，生命体往往只使用其中一种。
例如，构成蛋白质的氨基酸虽然存在两种镜像形式，但生命系统几乎只选择其中一种，这种现象被称为“同手性”。
而在普通化学反应中，两种镜像分子通常会同时生成，如何让反应只偏向其中一种，一直是化学领域的重要难题。
1986年，亨利·B·卡根发现了不对称合成中的“非线性效应”，证明即使最初只有很小的手性差异，也能够在化学反应中被明显放大，从而让其中一种镜像分子占据优势。
随后，硖合宪三进一步将这一思路推向极致，1995年，他设计出一种具有不对称自催化能力的化学反应，生成的分子还能够继续催化自身生成，让原本非常微小的手性差异不断放大。
2003年，硖合宪三最终展示了一种只生成一种镜像形式的反应。
诺贝尔委员会指出，在此之前，除了生命本身，还没有人通过化学反应实现这一结果。
这项发现对于制药行业尤其重要。
原因在于，同一种药物分子的两种镜像结构可能具有完全不同的作用，其中一种能够产生治疗效果，另一种则可能效果较弱，甚至带来不必要的副作用。
因此，如何精准合成所需要的那一种分子，是现代药物研发中的重要环节。
诺贝尔化学委员会主席Heiner Linke表示，两人的研究为一个持续超过一个世纪的化学谜题提供了解答，即同手性究竟如何自发产生。

news.title: 莫氏鸡煲老板贷款300万建养鸡场 员工从180人减至30
news.summary: 爆火半年后，莫氏鸡煲既没有闭店消失，也没能延续数千客流的盛况。

content.v: 据蓝鲸新闻报道，爆火半年后，莫氏鸡煲既没有闭店消失，也没能延续数千客流的盛况。近期，莫氏鸡煲因经营状况再度引发围观。其客流显著回落，总店员工也从180人减至30多人。
今年4月，位于广东佛山市顺德区陈村镇绀现村的莫氏鸡煲意外爆红。其门店客流从日均10桌暴涨到限号200桌，单个排队号被黄牛卖到300元，有人驱车2000公里、排队7小时只为吃上一份鸡煲。走红后，莫氏鸡煲陆续在佛山、南宁、上海等地开出分店。其老店也从4张台扩张到60多张，儿女均已辞职全职在家帮忙。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_13/1233.jpg
但流量总有回落的时候。近几个月里，老莫几次回应“门店倒闭凉凉”的传闻，多家媒体报道称其活鸡日销量一度跌至几十只。
第三方数据平台显示，“莫氏鸡煲”抖音直播间近30天场均带货销售额约为2500-5000元，场均观看人次一万有余。而在爆火时期，其单场直播销售额便能达到100-250万，观看人次屡超百万。事实上，莫氏鸡煲走红大约两个月后，其直播间流量和销量就已经开始显著下滑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_13/1423.jpg
10月7日，蓝鲸记者从莫氏鸡煲总店处了解到，国庆假期头天客人并不算多，但后续几天都很满，高峰期需要排队。“等位时间不是很长，反正有人来又有人走，一直有人在。”
第一现场近日报道称，目前店里一天能卖300只鸡。这个数据大概有假期加成，后续或将回归常态。老莫此前曾在公开报道中透露日销约在100只鸡左右，周末饭点也需要排一排队。
蓝鲸记者了解到，目前莫氏鸡煲仍有6家分店，分别位于佛山大良、云浮新兴、南海里水、珠海、南宁和上海，此前的深圳开店计划现已暂缓。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261007_zy_red_164_13/1655.jpg

跟随云天河与伙伴们踏上寻仙之路，在经历中理解人物的追求。适合想重温经典仙侠剧情、偏爱回合制冒险的玩家。 《仙剑奇侠传7》
在人、神、魔交织的故事中体验即时动作战斗。适合喜欢仙侠人物与世界观，又希望战斗操作更直接的玩家。 《仙剑奇侠传3》
围绕轮回、人物前世今生与两把剑展开冒险，体验多角色旅程。适合重温系列经典，或喜欢传统仙侠RPG的玩家。
动手闯一关：横版、西游与科幻动作 《心渊梦境》
在手绘风格世界中探索非线性关卡，通过能力与角色成长打开新的道路。适合喜欢横版动作和大地图探索的玩家。 《无限机兵》
以拥有再生之躯的机兵阿丽莎为主角，在怪物横行的城市遗迹中寻找答案。适合喜欢科幻废土、角色成长与动作战斗的玩家。 《黑神话：悟空》
扮演天命人，在中国神话背景下踏上充满危险的西游之路。适合重视战斗与世界氛围的玩家；本次参考价对应豪华版。
按自己的节奏生活：经营、建设与修行 《一方灵田》
把种田、家园经营、门派建设与修仙养成结合，在山岚谷安排自己的生活。适合想慢慢经营，又不想离开仙侠世界的玩家。 《沙石镇时光》
作为新工坊主收集资源、制造设备，逐步建设家园并认识镇民。适合喜欢生活模拟、生产经营与小镇关系的玩家。 《了不起的修仙模拟器》
建立仙门、招收弟子，安排建筑与修行环境，再逐步发展门派。适合喜欢复杂经营系统、愿意研究修行路线的玩家。 《犹格索托斯的庭院》
经营一座奇异旅社，招募员工、迎接客人，再用不同方式积累资产。适合喜欢经营与AVG故事交织的玩家。
换个视角体验：战棋、抉择与民俗谜题 《圣女战旗》
在架空法国大革命背景中指挥军队，体验战棋与人物成长。它是国产制作、海外历史题材，适合喜欢站位与兵种配合的玩家。 《江山北望》
在政局与个人追求之间做选择，让分支决定角色走向。适合喜欢历史背景、文字叙事与多路线探索的玩家。 《苏丹的游戏》
在宫廷背景下应对残酷的卡牌任务，安排资源、人物与行动。适合喜欢复杂抉择、愿意尝试不同应对路线的玩家。 《镇邪》
以道门弟子的身份调查村庄，在民俗故事和道术玩法中面对危险。适合喜欢中式灵异题材与探索冒险的玩家。 《疑案追声》
回到案发现场聆听声音，通过角色对话和行动还原真相。适合愿意仔细听线索、靠自己的推理破解案件的玩家。 《纸嫁衣2奘铃村》
走入奘铃村，在诡异习俗与村庄历史中寻找答案。适合喜欢中式民俗氛围、剧情与解谜相结合的玩家。 《纸嫁衣3鸳鸯债》
跟随新的故事进入末水村与浮路市，面对民俗背后的谜团。适合想继续体验系列，或偏爱中式恐怖解谜的玩家。 《灵墟》
在仙侠世界中接触任务、英魂记忆与不同人物，通过探索和成长决定自己的方向。适合喜欢文字表达、自由养成与江湖奇遇的玩家。

news.title: 15000块！新掌机性能和价格都离谱 玩黑猴可百帧
news.summary: 近日，MobileSyrup发布了微星新款掌机Claw 8 EX AI+的评测，并以“性能和价格都离谱”形容这款产品。

content.v: 近日，MobileSyrup发布了微星新款掌机Claw 8 EX AI+的评测，并以“性能和价格都离谱”形容这款产品。
该机售价高达2200美元（约合人民币14750元），搭载英特尔Arc G3 Extreme处理器，被评测者认为是目前性能最强的PC游戏掌机之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072157127625.png
评测内容较多，本文为您摘录MobileSyrup的主要评测内容。
Claw 8 EX AI+采用8英寸1920×1200 IPS屏幕，支持48-120Hz可变刷新率，重量785克，并配备霍尔摇杆、双雷电4接口以及1TB PCIe 4.0 SSD。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072157276713.png
性能是该机最大的亮点。评测中，《极限竞速：地平线5》在1920×1200分辨率、高画质下可达到78帧，将PL1和PL2提高至35W和45W后则提升至110帧。《黑神话：悟空》开启XeSS后可以达到约50至60帧，开启帧生成后进一步提升至85至110帧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072157399219.png
不过，高性能也带来了续航问题。Claw 8 EX AI+配备80Wh电池，耐力模式下游戏续航约3小时，而满功耗运行时仅有约1小时，想要长时间运行3A游戏基本需要连接电源。
评测同时批评了售价对应的屏幕配置：2200美元的掌机仍然使用500尼特IPS面板，而部分竞争产品已经采用OLED屏幕。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072157527846.png
MobileSyrup认为，Claw 8 EX AI+拥有出色的性能、散热和操控体验，但2200美元的售价已经进入游戏本甚至高端PC的价格区间，加上高性能模式下严重的续航限制，使其更适合预算充足、追求极致掌机性能的玩家。

news.title: M站85分新游获满分盛赞 类银恐怖 各方各面都很棒
news.summary: 近日，CGMagazine公布了恐怖冒险新作《银松镇》（Silver Pines）的评测，并为游戏打出10/10满分，该作目前M站均85分。

content.v: 近日，CGMagazine公布了恐怖冒险新作《银松镇》（Silver Pines）的评测，并为游戏打出10/10满分，该作目前M站均85分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072100569166.png
评测认为，本作是一封写给《寂静岭》和《双峰镇》的情书，同时将悬疑侦探、生存恐怖与银河城玩法结合在一起，形成了自己的特色。
评测尤其肯定了游戏的场景设计。银松镇本身就像一个拥有生命的角色，玩家需要逐渐熟悉城镇结构，在调查过程中不断发现新的道路、线索与秘密。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072101217811.jpg
CGMagazine认为，本作的手绘画面结合转描动画，营造出了类似图像小说的梦幻质感，配合新黑色电影风格，让游戏形成了鲜明的视觉特色。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072101485717.jpg
在玩法方面，《银松镇》将生存恐怖与银河城元素结合。玩家会遇到大量锁住的房门和无法通过的道路，获得新的能力或道具后再返回探索。由于整个过程与侦探调查结合，回溯并不会显得单纯重复，而更像是在跟进此前发现的新线索。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072101285570.jpg
资源管理也是评测重点称赞的部分。游戏中的金钱不仅用于购买弹药、电池和治疗物品，还与存档机制直接关联，玩家需要在补充物资和保留存档资金之间做出选择，再加上有限的背包空间，进一步强化了生存恐怖体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072101389263.jpg
此外，CGMagazine还称赞了游戏的音效、配音以及谜题设计。《银松镇》不会过度提示玩家，而是要求玩家自行整理笔记、寻找线索并解决谜题。部分后期谜题甚至需要玩家认真记录信息才能破解，而解开谜题后的成就感也成为评测者特别认可的体验。
最终，CGMagazine表示，《银松镇》并非单纯复制经典恐怖作品，而是在吸收《寂静岭》《双峰镇》等作品特点的基础上建立了自己的身份，并将其形容为“阴郁、华丽、聪明，同时在恐怖之下拥有强烈的人性”。

news.title: PS5模拟器短时间显著进化！已有36款游戏被拿下
news.summary: 据Playground报道，PS5模拟器SharpEmu近期兼容性出现明显提升。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072034398796.png
据Playground报道，PS5模拟器SharpEmu近期兼容性出现明显提升。目前项目已经测试了76款PS5游戏，其中36款能够进入实际游戏流程，包括24款被标记为“Playable”以及12款处于“Ingame”状态。
按照SharpEmu官方的分类标准，“Playable”意味着游戏可以正常游玩至通关，仅存在少量问题或基本没有明显问题；“Ingame”则代表已经能够进入实际游戏流程，但仍存在较为严重的错误。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072034509000.png
相比不到一周前的测试结果，SharpEmu此前仅有62款游戏完成测试，其中22款能够进入游戏流程。也就是说，短时间内能够进入游戏流程的作品数量增加了14款。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610072034593770.png
截至10月7日，已有3款游戏获得“可游玩”评级，分别为《波斯王子：失落的王冠》《迪士尼幻梦岛：与米奇和朋友们历险》以及《Little Big Adventure - 特文森的任务》。此外，《神探杰克鼠》也已经能够进入游戏，但目前仍被归类为“Ingame”。
SharpEmu是一款面向PC的PlayStation 5模拟器，目前仍处于开发阶段。随着兼容游戏数量持续增加，越来越多PS5作品已经能够在PC上进入实际游戏画面。

news.title: 太魔幻！B站和小红书两个世界 同一款游戏天差地别

content.v: 转载自微信公众号：GameQuest
文 / 游戏那点事 弦问
有时候换个平台看同一款游戏，真会怀疑自己是不是进错了社区。
前段时间，我玩的一款游戏版更后起了节奏，同时也在B站引起了热议。我便顺嘴问朋友：“这次节奏你怎么看？”
她却一脸茫然。聊两句才发现，她最近在小红书上刷到的都是新装扮的内容，还有一个我完全没听过、据说已经传挺广的梗。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_11132880_4863058.jpg
（我们玩的真是一个游戏？）
等她反问我时，我也愣了，明明玩的是同一个游戏，怎么在不同的平台，和朋友之间还隔了层“可悲的厚障壁”？
这种情况其实还真不少见。一些用户量大、玩法多面的游戏，换个平台看，社区画风可能就会大相径庭。
其中最典型的，可能就是把“战斗成长”和“社交生活”都做成核心内容的MMO了。
就拿两个月前刚上线的MMO游戏为例，开服不久，B站上的讨论很快就进入了“老MMO玩家模式”，创作内容相当一部分都在围绕职业强弱、团本攻略、打桩方式等主旋律话题。
但到了小红书，讨论方向似乎更偏向于分享体验。捏脸、装扮、场景打卡、剧情角色相关更容易引起共鸣，配合诡秘朋友圈功能，玩家们把游戏从“一款新MMO”，变成了“我在XX世界里怎么生活”。
此外， 把外观穿搭做成核心卖点的竞技游戏，几乎都有这种跨平台的画风突变。 像《永劫无间》这种强调操作和对抗的多人动作竞技游戏，“外观”内容在小红书上却一直都是高频话题，“永劫暖暖”作为上线时的一个梗，早早就成了小红书里最常见的Tag之一。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_11132880_4863059.jpg
《和平精英》就更明显了，到了小红书，玩家们更是把“和平穿搭”发展成了一门单独的学问。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_11132880_4863057.jpg
玩家不只琢磨角色身上的套装怎么混搭，还会把造型搬到现实，做同款攻略。在今年8月，《和平精英》曾举行与外观主题高度绑定的“刺激之夜”，相关讨论的热度也要更集中在小红书和抖音。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_11132880_4863061.jpg
更让我意外的是，就连《三角洲行动》也能长出不同的社区生态。毕竟按理说，“搜打撤”已经算相当硬核的品类，过去社区里最有存在感的内容，大多还是围绕核心玩法展开；即便到了B站，跳出玩法之外，最活跃的往往也是角色二创和动画整活。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_11132880_4863064.jpg
但到了小红书，具有生活感的另一面就被放大了出来。尤其《三角洲行动》今年在小红书的一轮平台推广里，MBTI、情侣开黑日常、干员仿妆、穿搭、手工等内容被集中摆到台前，也让《三角洲行动》有了不少“小红书味”的生活化表达。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_11132880_4863060.jpg
说到这里就会发现， 这种社区差异的背后，其实是玩家根据自己的兴趣和需求，主动聚到更合适的平台上。 玩家群体被精准导向后，就容易生长出不同的社区气氛。
所以说，开头那种情况也就不难理解了：同一个版本改动，在B站已经吵得热火朝天，到了另一个平台却显得“无人在意”。
不过，这种差异也并不意味着玩家群体的完全割裂。正相反，在不同平台上活跃的也可能是同一拨人。
现在不少玩家已经对不同平台形成了一种默契。比方说想要搜详细的游戏攻略，有着长视频优势、“B站大学”戏称的B站可能是最合适的选择；
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_11132880_4863063.jpg
（B站从数分钟到半小时的教程应有尽有）
而如果是短视频教程，或是捏脸、服装搭配，乃至仿妆、手工等经验分享的内容，小红书丰富的图文、短视频分享形态，也有自己的领域长板。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_11132880_4863065.jpg
总之， 对于玩家而言，他们只是知道自己想要什么，并选择了更方便、合适的内容平台。
但对厂商来说，这或许就意味着用户反馈更难取舍。 这也是为什么我们总能见到很多游戏的版本改动会陷入“一刀切”的争议，本质上还是难以同时照顾到所有玩家的诉求。
而一旦长时间偏向某一类声音，就很容易让一部分玩家感受到被忽视，甚至导致流失。久而久之，版本方向也会失衡，社区维护变得更加复杂。
类似的情况，在一些具体改动上会表现得更突出。比如前段时间，某游戏在测试阶段曾调整过女角色的服装尺度，这在小红书上更多是认可和叫好，但在B站上却引发了相当一部分玩家的不满，甚至有玩家捕风捉影，认为官方是不是偏向于参考另一个平台的意见。
这种猜测当然无法证实，服装尺度这种敏感因素的调整，本就是厂商经常需要面对的事情。但它至少暴露了一个问题：不同社区对同一内容的期待可能是不一致的。
当然，不是所有厂商都有这种烦恼，毕竟也不是每款游戏都能生长出不同的社区生态，它本身就意味着产品需要装得下足够复杂的用户需求。
某种程度上，这也是游戏不断追求大DAU、扩大用户盘之后出现的结果： 游戏越来越讲究面向泛用户，而玩家群体也愈发会表达自己的需求。
于是到了今天，很多大DAU游戏其实很难再找到一个统一的“核心玩家群体”，策划也越来越不能用一个“大多数玩家”来思考问题。
所以再回到开头，B站、小红书还是其它平台上，游戏当然是同一款游戏。只是有人在研究打桩，有人在研究穿搭；有人在找攻略，有人在找搭子。
比起再问“玩家想要什么”，或许游戏人更应该问的是：“这些不同的玩家，分别是因为什么愿意留下来？”

news.title: PS5又被完全破解？甚至能玩Xbox游戏 索尼紧急更新

content.v: 毫无疑问，在主机这个领域，破解永远是一个绕不开的命题。对于某些技术大佬来说，这种与厂家的攻坚比起游戏来更能让他们疯狂分泌多巴胺。就在前几天，PS被完全破解的消息再一次传了出来。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862877.gif
这种消息其实每年都会出现几次，不过这次不一样，这次这个代号为Relapse的玩意是一个完整的漏洞利用链，从浏览器入口一路捅到内核物理内存读写权限，支持固件版本从7.00到13.60，覆盖初版厚机、Slim薄机，甚至连去年刚出的PS5 Pro都没能幸免。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862872.jpg
本着互联网精神，开发者Nathan Fargo已经把代码开源，只需要打开PS5浏览器，输入一个网址，等几秒就可以完成——是的，只需要几秒。
那么问题来了，这些完成破解的玩家们都做了些什么呢？他们在用PS5玩Xbox 360的游戏。是的，姬没开玩笑，据说现在破解社区已经有人用Xbox 360模拟器在PS5上跑起了《GTA4》，也不知道索尼官方知道这个消息之后会是什么表情。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862871.gif
这一次的Relapse功能确实强大，但它却并非持续性破解，换句话说就是每次关机重启之后都得重新跑一次流程，虽说破解一次只用几秒，但每次都来这么一手也挺麻烦的。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862873.jpg
当然更重要的是，在破解之后玩家也将失去多人在线游戏、数字商店、云存档以及系统更新等功能，另外奖杯系统也会受到不小的限制。至于破解之后的系统不稳定，数据丢失甚至封号这些风险，自然是存在的。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862874.jpg
索尼在Relapse公开后仅仅两天就紧急推送了14.10固件，其核心目的就是封堵漏洞。这个反应速度也是可以证明，索尼平时那些如同龟爬的更新速度真的就是他们不上心，真的想快的话他们是可以很快的。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862875.jpg
除此之外，索尼其实还有个后招，他们表示即将上市的《GTA6》要求PS5固件版本不低于14.10.00。而Relapse支持的固件上限是13.60。中间隔着0.5个版本号，就是一道天堑。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862876.jpg
现在让我们回到最初的问题——PS5真的完全被破解了么？从技术上来说是的。从7.00到13.60，厚机薄机Pro机，一个都没跑掉。内核级权限，几秒完成，开源代码，人人都能做。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862879.gif
但从实际意义上，姬觉得这次也是破解了个寂寞。PS5这么贵的东西，大家真的舍得只用它玩模拟器么？而且现如今玩家们的追求比起当年不仅仅是可以玩到游戏了，建立在此之上的各种社交内容早就成为了游玩体验中不可或缺的一部分。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_5494539_4862878.jpg
可能，这就是现如今破解游戏机的最大障碍吧。
晚安。

news.title: 这次不用万一 兔娘真的是好女孩！

content.v: 《互联网女菩萨蛮》
屏中艳影轻相付，引得尘心无数。
软语慰风尘，虚称天上人。
一朝舆论起，褒贬皆浮戏。
色相本寻常，何妨共嗅香。
相传观音菩萨见尘世欲根深重，化为美色之女，投身妓馆，一般接客；以至于现在我们看到互联网上慷慨分享自己美好肉体的女孩，都会亲切的叫一声“女菩萨”，这既是对她心胸宽广的赞美，也是在肯定她为人与人之间的和谐共存做出的贡献。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862828.jpg
而作为一名根正苗红、遵纪守法的良好中国公民，我肯定是不可能干出什么越界行为去什么外面的地方找什么女菩萨来满足自己什么不可告人的观赏欲望的，再说了，咱们国内的女菩萨也不少！
至少在这一点上，我们还没有被外国卡脖子。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862827.jpg
（你，去把Yasal干掉）
当然，在一般情况下，虽然深受各位女菩萨的布施，但我们还是不会把女菩萨叫做“好女孩”的，除非她的名字叫做“兔娘”。
我们今天要说的，是“人民的兔娘”：一颗小兔娘。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862826.jpg
而为什么仅仅是一位随处可见的女主播，就能够在人民群众当中获得“人民的兔娘”这一宏大的称号呢？
那么我们就不能不提她的来时路了。
兔娘，本名熊莉，1999年生于四川成都，毕业于四川师范大学数学系，并成功取得了教师资格证。在如今一众鱼龙混杂的互联网主播中，她的本科文凭就已经足够让她名列前茅。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862829.jpg
而作为师范生毕业的兔娘，最初的梦想自然不是在漫展上帮兄弟们涂护手霜，而是成为一名真正的人民教师。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862836.gif
但可能是因为害怕自己哪天在办公桌上收到学生偷偷塞在抽屉里的信件，正面是告白的情书，背面是不答应的遗书，总之为了不让自己好不容易考到的教资如奶油一般化开，最终兔娘还是没有走上这条教书育人的道路。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862831.jpg
（学生在攻击你的教资）
据她所说，考教资其实是很简单的一件事，只要会背书就能考过，真正困难的是教师编制，而自己就是在这点上望而却步了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862833.jpg
而我证明，确实是这样的，因为本人也有一本高中数学教师资格证，某种意义上和兔娘曾经是同行。
所以之后难道我也要在漫展上给兄弟们摸手手吗？！
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862832.jpg
总之，教师育人道路失利的兔娘选择了在网上开启自己的直播事业，在最早的时候，其实兔娘并不是以“擦边”为自己的主业，当时她主攻的方向是“炉石传说”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862835.jpg
没错，在当时并没有多少炉石女主播的情况下，兔娘就已经凭借较好的面容签约网易，成功混上了每月一万四的低保。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862834.jpg
但不幸的是，在半年之后，国服就停运了，于是，曾经的炉石主播兔娘就此一去不复还，如今剩下的，只有让兄弟们“炉石”的主播。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862837.jpg
为了生计，兔娘只能“下海”当起了“擦边”主播，穿上Cos装拍些小广告来养家糊口。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3341818_4862838.jpg
但有别于其他Coser而言，兔娘有着得天独厚的优势，并不是说她的身材“可塑性”极强，而是她确实够抽象。
当然，在某种意义上来讲，兔娘火的原因也包括她确实不拿兄弟们当外人。
同样，我这也不是在说她足够慷慨，在身材展示上非常考虑兄弟们的需求，毕竟兔娘的身材“水分”确实很大。
我的意思是，除了在兔娘这里，你应该很难再看到有哪位好看的小姐姐会愿意带着开口器给你全方面的展示自己的口腔。
（害怕！）
就，怎么说呢……她跟别人不一样！
别的女主播都是在互联网上精心维持着自己的人设，生怕露出什么不好的表情破坏了自己的形象，把自己活成了一个互联网符号和标签。
但兔娘不怕！她甚至还给兄弟们看过自己过敏脸肿成猪头时最丑的样子，直到现在，我们仍未得知楚楚baby的下落。
而让兔娘第一次在互联网上成功出圈的操作，还要得益于她的“教资”。
试问，如果有一天在深夜你兴致上来了，在抖音输入了“开导”，希望在这个寂寞的夜晚让自己的思维回归宁静，而这个时候你看到了一个身穿粉色长裙的小姐姐，温柔的对你说着“老师带你一起导一下”。
然后啪地一声她就搞来一块白板开始给你讲解“导数”的知识。
这个时候你充血的小头不由自主的回忆起当初在高中课堂上你的中年秃头数学男老师告诉你的口诀：连续不一定可导，可导一定连续。
而现在已经连续不上了，所以不可导，该睡了。
不过在此我必须向大家做一个辟谣，在现在的很多文章、视频都说兔娘曾在足浴店工作，并因为老板拖欠工资才走上互联网擦边的不归路。
但是这是不对的！
谣言的发生其实源于她拍摄的“足浴小妹”段子，只能说兔娘确实漂亮，演技确实好，台词背的确实熟。
以致于被收录进了《大型纪录片》频道中，从此骗过了一波又一波的后来者。
但到目前为止，如果仅仅只是这样，兔娘依旧只是一位在互联网上稍有些姿色的美女主播而已，或许能吸引不少LSP的关注，但绝对达不到1140万粉丝这么夸张。
真正让她获得人民认可的，是她对所有粉丝一视同仁的敬业态度，以及把小厨南玩弄在股掌之间的手段。
不要啊！不要这样对我的兄弟！
兄弟们这辈子都没主动摸过女孩子的手，拍照比个心都手忙脚乱的，活了20多年除了小学什么时候和女孩子坐这么近过；
现在你主动和兄弟们十指相扣，帮他们摆爱心手势，和他们贴贴，摸他们的脸，你让他们以后还怎么忘记你！
大家不要被兔娘骗了啊，快回山洞里面来，今天大厨给大家做了最喜欢吃的史莱姆炖野狗，不要被这种奸诈的女精灵蛊惑了，她只是馋你好不容易收集的金币而已啊！
（回家后的兔娘be like）

news.title: 《高达》新游完全不像高达！官方：我们故意的

content.v: 在约一小时试玩后，我们与《GUNDAM 异轨征途》制作人富山勇也、总监芹泽义行进行联访。本作是万代南梦宫全新企划“RG Project”中原创的一款动作新品，计划 2027 年 3 月 5 日登陆 PS5、Xbox Series 与 PC，并与动画《机动战士高达RG XARX-ZERO》共享世界观；玩家扮演沉默寡言的王牌机师雷克斯，驾驶螺旋高达搭档青年音的哈啰“惟”迎战被称为“天启”的巨大地外生命体。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3496476_4862649.jpg
左：制作人富山勇也，右：总监芹泽义行
本作战斗主打高机动近战、爽快手感与部位破坏，支持机体部件自定义、MOD 外观，通关后之后还会开放最大支持 3 人的合作模式挑战强敌。
以下为本次访谈的主要内容。
——正式版机体的装备、零件主要靠什么获取？是商店直接买、固定解锁，还是反复刷任务？
开发团队：通关任务后可获得开发素材，带到“开发装置”里制作机体零件和武器。开发素材有两个来源：一是在任务地图探索途中直接拾取，二是任务完成后的报酬发放。
关于随机性，用固定素材开发出来的武器或零件，性能是一致的，不是随机产出。也就是说玩家可以靠反复刷任务积累素材，再按自己想要的配装定向开发。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3496476_4862651.jpg
—— 刚才制作人展示了类似“换皮肤”的系统，正式版有没有预设高达型号的方案？玩家能否分享自制外观？换外观后动作模组会不会冲突？
芹泽：这套功能暂称外观 Mod Skin，定位是纯换外观，不改变动作。机体怎么动，仍按它实际装备的零件和武器来表现。
预设方案方面，正式版会提供外观选择，但玩家自制外观不支持在游戏内互相分享。
至于“看起来违和”的问题 —— 比如外观像 RX-78 元祖高达，手上却拿螺旋高达的武器，或者背上挂浮游、推进单元但原机没有对应动作 —— 开发团队会做相应的调整。最典型的是推进器单元，遇到视觉冲突时会把冲突部分（例如多余喷口或背部单元）直接隐藏，避免动作和外形打架。
富山：这类外观冲突是开发期反复讨论的点，目标是不让换皮影响操作辨识度。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3496476_4862653.jpg
内容预告中揭示了 3 款 MOD Skin Set
—— 高达系列动画和游戏里很多主题是不同势力的人类之间的故事，本作改成对战大型外星生物，请问这样设计的初衷是什么？
富山：本作目标群体包含没接触过高达的新玩家，所以先从“原创动作”而不是“IP 复刻”出发。从一开始就引入了很多原创的新概念，之后再加入大量动作功能，并且反复试错，最终变成现在的样子。
芹泽：虽然是 MS 对巨型外星生命体，不像传统人类互斗，但剧情里依然保留人与人的纠葛、人性抉择。我们希望用“高达vs天启”的强视觉表现力吸引玩家，再用一如既往的感人故事让玩家们留下。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3496476_4862647.jpg
—— 我作为几十年的高达 IP 老粉丝，看到本作首曝预告的时候完全认不出是这是一款高达主题的游戏，请问机体设定是故意和以往的风格进行了切割吗？以后是否会推出模型周边？
富山：机体由 Bandai Namco Studio 经验丰富的美术负责。这次刻意挑战新概念，就是想要想展示“高达本身的魅力”而不只是怀旧符号，除了主角螺旋高达之外，其他登场机体也由深谙系列的美术按“让粉丝兴奋”的方向设计。
金属质感、MS 体积感、与巨大外星人同框的压迫感，都是重点呈现项，动画过场中也会加入很多机体的细节，不过设计团队也同时保留了“一眼能认出是高达”的特征，并不是彻底推倒重来。
至于拼装模型、周边商品，我们作为游戏开发团队，目前暂时无法给出相关信息，如果将来确定会推出模型、玩具或其他商品，会通过相关渠道进行公布。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3496476_4862650.jpg
左：HG 1/144 螺旋高达，右：HG 1/144 螺旋高达（地球蓝 Ver.）
——在之前的采访中制作人有提到多人合作挑战强敌的模式要通关之后才能解锁，请问为什么不直接开放？
开发团队：合作挑战强敌定位为“通关后重复游玩要素”，不是前期主线内容。原因主要有两点，第一是本作的故事情节中包含大量人性纠葛的元素，我们希望玩家先完整体验本作的剧情，深刻了解雷克斯与“惟”的互动，第二是很多玩家想用自定义机体反复与强敌对战，所以把合作对战强敌的这一元素放在通关之后，作为一个长期的玩法。
—— 系列传统上多用活泼女声来为哈啰配音，而在本作中“惟”的配音则是一名略带磁性的青年音，请问这是基于剧情设定还是制作人的个人喜好?
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3496476_4862652.jpg
富山：相关细节我们计划跟随后续随剧情逐步公开，不过在这里可以先给各位透露一下 —— “惟”在本作中绝不是纯粹的吉祥物，而是正式登场的角色。本作采用了完全原创的全新世界观，虽然在外观上仍是大家十分熟悉的哈啰，但内在设定完全不同。
芹泽：雷克斯作为螺旋高达的王牌机师，在成长线里台词并不多，惟负责在旁边持续对话、推进故事。青年音是为了配合“正式角色化”这一设定方向所做的设定，不是单纯恶搞。
制作人寄语
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/07/origin_3496476_4862648.jpg
富山勇也：本作是充满挑战的高达主题动作游戏新品，挑战之一是把“高达是什么”讲给完全不了解系列的人听。我们看过各家媒体试玩报道，知道大家都能感觉到它和过去高达游戏不一样，但可以保证的是本作中的机体、系统、故事都是由深爱高达的人共同打磨，希望能够带给老粉新鲜感，同时能够吸引新玩家以本作为切入点继续拓展关于高达的知识。
芹泽义行：高达近年靠动画、游戏、模型持续扩圈，亚洲地区的粉丝们尤其热情。本作作为动作游戏，目标就是让人第一眼觉得“这游戏好爽、好想上手玩一玩”。欢迎所有高达粉丝和新玩家都来试试看，不仅战斗本身乐趣十足，故事情节也十分有看点，通关后还能跟好友联机闯关，整体可玩度非常高。

news.title: PC版GTA6或要到2028年！GS：起码等15个月
news.summary: 近日，GameSpot撰写了一篇指南类文章，简要阐述了他们对于《GTA6》PC版发售日期的预测以及相关的分析。

content.v: 近日，GameSpot撰写了一篇指南类文章，简要阐述了他们对于《GTA6》PC版发售日期的预测以及相关的分析。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610071938528757.png
GameSpot认为，《GTA6》PC版发售时间将落在2028年第一季度，这意味着PC版大约会在主机版发售15至18个月后推出。这一预测并非基于任何泄露消息或业内人士爆料，而是参考Rockstar过去晚于主机版推出PC版的历史情况得出的。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610071939059957.jpg
这一时间早于PC玩家等待《给他爱5》PC版时经历的19个月，但晚于《荒野大镖客：救赎2》从主机版发售到PC版推出之间的12个月间隔。由于Twitch CEO Dan Clancy无意中透露，《GTA6》的多人模式将在2027年的某个时候推出，因此GameSpot对这一预测很有信心。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610071939192008.jpg
话虽如此，Rockstar目前甚至还没有正式宣布《GTA6》的PC版。该公司目前列出的游戏官方平台只有PS5和Xbox Series X|S。不过，如果《GTA6》最终永远不登陆PC，那将会非常令人意外。Rockstar最近两款大型作品最终都登陆了PC，而Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick也曾多次承认PC如今对公司业务的重要性。

news.title: “龟速车”占道致车辆堵成长龙 交警霸气喊话
news.summary: 高速公路上出现了“龟速车占道”的情况。视频中的小轿车在超车道低速行驶，直接让后方大批车辆堵成了长龙。交警随即通过通讯设备对…

content.v: 据报道，国庆期间，高速公路上出现了“龟速车占道”的情况。视频中的小轿车在超车道低速行驶，直接让后方大批车辆堵成了长龙。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610071759522888.png
交警随即通过通讯设备对该车驾驶员进行提醒，要求车辆提速，并喊话驾驶员，若无法提速，驶出隧道后尽快靠右驶入慢车道。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610071800052165.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/07/small_202610071802176655.png
高速快车道的功能是供车辆超车使用，长时间低速占用超车道，极易形成交通瓶颈，短时间内就会造成后方车流堆积，不仅降低通行效率，还会增加追尾、剐蹭事故的风险。
这一幕也引发网友热议。有网友称：“希望全国各地的高速路上都有交警巡逻（包括无人机）提示警告慢速车、大货车长期霸占超车道，尽量避免交通事故发生。”还有网友直言：“开不快就别上高速了，高速路不是练车场。”
高速通行有速度与车道使用规则，驾驶员需要按车辆时速选择对应车道。在不具备高速行驶条件时，应当主动靠右行驶，避免在快车道低速压车，共同保障高速路网通行顺畅。
